blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We measure the emotion geometry of six LLMs spanning Google's Gemma 2 family. Using an extraction pipeline established by Sofroniew et al. (2026) on Claude Sonnet 4.5 and replicated by Hollowell (2026) on Gemma 2 27B base, we compare emotion geometry across base and instruction-tuned variants of Gemma 2 2B, 9B, and 27B. First, all six model cells exhibit the core emotion geometry. A linear map fit between two cells places held-out emotions nearest their own vectors in the target model. Across all fifteen model pairs, fit in one direction each, this failed exactly once, and the median rank was 1 in every pair. Linear maps refit on cleaned embedding-table vectors recover every held-out emotion at rank 1 in all thirty ordered pairs. Second, scale spreads the geometry's variance across more directions without weakening its tie to valence. The leading component's share of variance falls from 31.6 percent (2B) to 29.8 (9B) to 26.7 (27B) in the base models and from 31.9 (2B) to 29.2 (9B) to 27.3 (27B) in the tuned ones, while its correlation with human valence ratings stays between .71 and .78 in all six models. Third, we project each emotion vector onto the output vocabulary and ask at what depth the vector's own emotion word enters the top 10,000 of the 256,000 tokens. In the 2B and 9B models the median emotion word is there from layer 0, while in the 27B models it begins near chance, stays outside the top 10,000 for half the network, and enters at layer 23 in one step. Fourth, tuning leaves every registered analysis-layer measure within its floor. At every size, valence correlation rises and arousal correlation falls by amounts within their floors, the latter against prediction. PC2's variance share also falls, with a pooled decrease significant after correction. Mid-late layer stability exceeds its floor and traces to base 27B's final layer. Code, data, and audit reports are released.
blocks.zh: 我们测量了Google的Gemma 2家族 6个LLMs的情感几何 使用由Sofroniew等人(2026年)在克洛德·索内 4.5上所建立的取出管由Hollowell(2026年)在Gemma 2 27B基上所复制的取出管,我们比较了Gemma 2 2B,9B和27B基上跨基的情感几何和指令调取的变体. 首先,所有6个模型细胞都展现出核心情感几何. 一个线性映射在目标模型中两个细胞间 距离它们自己的向量最近的被搁置的情绪 15个型号中,每个型号都适合一个方向, 这一次完全失败, 中位数是每对1。 在清理后嵌入式载体上的线性地图 恢复了所有30对订单中第1级的被搁置的情绪 第二,尺度将几何体的相差分散到更多的方向,而不会削弱其与活率的结合. 主要组成部分在差异中所占的份额从基本模型的31.6%(2B)下降到29.8%(9B)到26.7%(27B),从调制模型的31.9%(2B)下降到29.2%(9B)到27.3%(27B),而在所有6个模型中,它与人类价值评级的关联仍然在.71至.78之间。 第三,我们把每个情感矢量投射到输出词汇中,并询问矢量自身的情感单词在什么深度进入了256,000个令牌中的前一万个. 在2B和9B模型中,中位情感词从第0层存在,而在第27B模型中,它开始接近偶然性,停留在前一万外为半个网络,一步进入第23层. 第四,调整将每个注册分析层的量度留在地上。 在每一个大小上,能量的相通性会上升,而激发的相通性会因下层的相通性而下降,后者与预测相对. PC2的差异份额也有所下降,更正后集合减少幅度很大。 中后期地层稳定性超过地层,并有痕迹可追溯到地基27B的最后地层. 公布代码、数据和审计报告。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Sofroniew et al. (2026) extracted vectors for 171 emotions from Claude Sonnet 4.5 ( Anthropic, 2025 ) and found them organized via a strong valence axis, a weaker and more variable arousal axis, soft but stable emotion families, and high family cohesion. Hollowell (2026) replicated that emotion structure in an open-weights model, Gemma 2 27B base, inheriting the extraction pipeline unchanged. How the core emotion geometry holds across scale and tuning, however, remains an open question.
blocks.zh: Sofroniew等 (2026)从克洛德·索内4.5(英语:Claude Sonnet 4.5 (Anthropic, 2025))中提取出171个情绪的向量,并发现它们通过强大的活性轴,更弱更可变的振荡轴,柔软但稳定的情绪家族,以及高家庭凝聚力来组织. 霍洛威尔(2026年)在开放量子模型"Gemma 2 27B Base"中复制了这种情感结构,继承了提炼管不变. 然而,核心情感几何如何横跨尺度和调整仍然是一个有待解决的问题。

blocks.en: We apply the pipeline from Sofroniew et al. (2026) to the Gemma 2 family at three sizes, 2B, 9B, and 27B, each in base and instruction-tuned form, for six model cells. Figure 1 shows each cell’s layer count, with its analysis layer marked at 2 / 3 \nicefrac{{2}}{{3}} depth.
blocks.zh: 我们从Sofroniew等人(2026年)将管道应用到Gemma 2家族,其尺寸为3个,分别为2B,9B和27B,每组为基数和指令调制,用于6个模型细胞. 图1显示每个单元格的地层计数,其分析地层标记为2 / 3\nicefrac {{2}}{{3}}.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Model depths and analysis layers for base and instruction-tuned Gemma 2 at 2B, 9B, and 27B.
blocks.zh: 图1:基座和指令调制的Gemma 2在2B,9B,27B的模型深度和分析层.

blocks.en: We define core emotion geometry as the structure common to both Claude Sonnet 4.5 in Sofroniew et al. (2026) and Gemma 2 27B base in Hollowell (2026) , and we measure it in every cell as four properties: a valence axis, a weaker and more variable arousal axis, soft but stable family partitions, and family cohesion. We count a cell as showing the core emotion geometry when it passes a pre-stated test of the two axes, which requires that its valence and arousal correlations with human ratings are both significant by permutation (p ≤ \leq .02 over 5,000 shuffles) and that the arousal correlation is the weaker of the two. We report family partitions and cohesion in every cell alongside base 27B’s published values. The registration predicted directions for these measures but did not specify effect-size floors or pass criteria.
blocks.zh: 我们把核心情感几何定义为Claude Sonnet 4.5在Sofroniew等人(2026年)和Gemma 2 27B在Hollowell (2026年)中的共同结构,我们在每一个细胞中将其测量为四个属性:活性轴,更弱更可变的催生轴,软而稳定的家庭分化,以及家庭凝聚力. 我们计算出一个细胞在通过对两轴的预分化测试时显示核心情感几何,这要求其与人类收视率的活率和振动相关性既能通过分化而显著(p\\leq.02于5000个分化),而振动相关性是两者中最弱的. 我们报告每个细胞的家庭分裂和凝聚力, 登记工作预测了这些措施的方向,但没有具体说明效果大小的下限或通过标准。

blocks.en: We find that all six Gemma 2 cells exhibit the core emotion geometry (§4.1). The nine registered comparisons between cells find it closely shared, with pairwise-similarity agreement above .99 and family-partition agreement above its registered floor in all nine (§4.2). A linear map fit between two cells on four fifths of the emotions places the median held-out emotion at retrieval rank 1 of 171 in the target cell (§4.3).
blocks.zh: 我们发现所有6个Gemma 2细胞都显示出了核心情感几何(§4.1)。 9个登记在册的细胞之间的比较发现其高度相同,在全部9个细胞的上下层(第4.2节)中,双相比协议高于. 99. 在五分之四的情感上两个细胞相匹配的线性映射将中位被搁置出情感置于目标细胞171的检索级别(§4.3).

blocks.en: Part of this geometry is present before any layer runs (§5.1). Vectors built from each model’s token-embedding table, with no forward pass and cleaned of generic token statistics, correlate moderately with human valence ratings in every cell (r = .48 to .51) and only weakly with arousal ratings (r = .12 to .18, significant in no cell). Linear maps refit on embedding-table vectors keep median rank 1 in every pair (§5.1). Larger models place a smaller share of their emotion variance on the leading component, 31.6 percent at 2B against 26.7 at 27B in the base models, the opposite of our registered prediction, while its correlation with human valence ratings holds at .71 to .78 in all six cells (§5.2).
blocks.zh: 这种几何学的一部分在任何地层运行之前就存在(§5.1)。 从每个模型的标牌嵌入表所建的矢量,没有前传并清理出通用标牌统计,与每个单元格(r =.48至.51)中度地与人的价值评级相关,而且只与刺激评级(r = 12至. 线性地图在嵌入式表矢量上重置,每对中位数为一(§5.1)。 较大的模型将其情感差异的较小部分放在了主元件上,在基础模型中2B时为31.6%,而在27B时为26.7%,这与我们的注册预测相反,而它与人类价值评级的关联在所有六个细胞中为.71至.78(§5.2)。

blocks.en: In the 2B and 9B cells, each emotion vector’s own word, projected onto the output vocabulary, already ranks at median in the top few thousand of 256,000 output tokens at layer 0, while in both 27B cells it starts near chance and stays outside the top 10,000 until layer 23, exactly half depth, where it enters the top 10,000 in a single step (§6.2). The 27B geometry also consolidates at layer 23, though stricter readability thresholds are crossed later (§6.3).
blocks.zh: 在2B和9B细胞中,每个情感向量的自用词投射到输出词汇上,已经排入了上千个的中位数,在上千个的256,000个输出信使中位数的第0层中位数,而在上千个中位数中位数的27B细胞中,它开始近乎偶然,并停留在前一万个外到第23层,完全为半深度,其中它在一个步骤中进入前一万个(§6.2). 27B几何还合并了第23层,不过后来跨越了更严格的可读性阈值(§6.3).

blocks.en: Instruction tuning leaves every registered analysis-layer measure within its floor (§7.1). At every size, the valence correlation rises and the arousal correlation falls, the latter contrary to our prediction. PC2’s variance share also falls at every size, and its pooled decrease remains significant after correction (Table 4 ). The mid-late layer-stability contrast does exceed its floor, but §8.3 traces that result to base 27B’s final layer. Base and tuned activation profiles on neutral dialogues largely agree, though their finer differences are not preserved at 9B (§7.2). Tuning’s perturbation of the geometry grows across successive thirds of the network at every size, but the late rise at 27B depends on the final layer (§7.3). Tuning also displaces some emotions much more than others (§7.4).
blocks.zh: 指令调整将每一个注册分析层的量度置于其下层(第7.1节)。 与我们的预测相反,在每一个大小上, 能量的相通性都上升了, 刺激的相通性也下降了。 PC2的差额份额也相去甚远,在更正后,其集合减少仍然很大(表4)。 中后期的地层稳定对比确实超过了地层,但第8.3节的痕迹导致基数为27B的最后地层. 中性对话的基础和调制激活简介基本一致,尽管其更细微的差异没有保留在9B(§7.2). 图宁对几何学的扰动在网络的相接相接的三分之一之间以每个大小增长,但27B的后期上升取决于最后的地层(§7.3). Tuning 也取代了一些情绪,远远多于其他情绪(§7.4).

blocks.en: We distinguish registered, pre-stated, and unregistered analyses according to when and how we specified them. Registered means fixed in the preregistration before any grid data existed, with the measure, the predicted direction, and the effect-size floor locked together. Pre-stated means the plan was fixed before it ran, by a hash or by a dated filing, but after the registered work, so it binds us without the preregistration’s protection. Unregistered means none of these, and each unregistered analysis carries that label where its result is reported. Locked describes a plan fixed before running the relevant analyses, not necessarily at preregistration.
blocks.zh: 我们根据具体时间和方式区分已登记、预先申报和未登记的分析。 在任何网格数据存在之前,登记在预先登记中被固定的指向,测量,预测方向,效果大小的地层被锁在一起. 预报计划是指计划实施前,通过散列或备案日期确定,但在登记工作之后,因此在未预先登记的情况下,它约束了我们。 未登记的不意味着这些,每一份未登记的分析都带有报告结果的标签。 Locked描述了在进行相关分析之前确定的一项计划,不一定在预先登记时确定。

blocks.en: This study’s code, results, and audit prompts and reports are released at github.com/adamhollowell/emotion_probes/tree/main/gemma_grid . The vectors, activations, per-story slices, and bootstrap files are hosted in the companion repository at huggingface.co/adamhollowell/gemma-emotion-vectors . §11 lists what ships directly, what ships as recipes, and what can be re-derived from Gemma weights.
blocks.zh: 在github.com/adamhollowell/emotion_probes/tree/main/gemma_grid发布该研究的代码、结果以及审计提示和报告。 载体,活化,平面切片,和靴子夹文件被托管在伴生寄存处: huggingface.co/adamhollowell/gemma-emotion-vectors. §11列出了哪些船只是直接的,哪些船只是食谱,哪些可以从Gemma重量中再生.

blocks.en: 2 Background and related work
blocks.zh: 2. 背景和相关工作

blocks.en: Earlier this year Sofroniew et al. (2026) presented the most extensive characterization of emotion representations in a large language model to date, extracting 171 emotion vectors from the residual stream of Claude Sonnet 4.5. Hollowell (2026) replicated the representational core of the original study on base google/gemma-2-27b and showed that the model recovers the affective circumplex, the separation of valence and arousal, the family-level taxonomy, and a stable late-middle band containing their analysis layer at 2 / 3 \nicefrac{{2}}{{3}} depth. The base-model recovery showed that the valence axis, in particular, predates alignment training and remains stable across emotion-set sizes and model depth. Appendix B maps the correspondence between this study and Hollowell (2026) .
blocks.zh: 今年早些时候,Sofroniew等人(2026年)在迄今为止的大型语言模型中提出了最广泛的情感表现特征,从克洛德·索内 4.5的残余流中提取出171个情感向量. Hollowell (2026)在基地gogle/gemma-2-27b上复制了原始研究的表示核心,并显示该模型恢复了相生环,分出活性与活性,家族层面的分类学,以及一个稳定的后中后期波段,包含其分析层,深度为2/3\nicefrac{{2}}{{3}}. 基建模型恢复显示,特别是等离子轴比对训练早,在情感设定大小和模型深度之间保持稳定. 附 录 B绘制了本研究与Hollowell(2026)之间的对应.

blocks.en: Several recent studies also examine emotion representations in Gemma models. Choi and Weber (2026) show representational similarity between Gemma-2-9B and Mistral-7B, though they probe classification-prompt activations rather than extract emotion vectors. Keeman (2026) uses supervised probes and activation patching, not extracted vectors, on eight emotions in base and tuned pairs of Llama-3.2-1B, Llama-3-8B, and Gemma-2-9B. Presa and Teles de Oliveira (2026) study compositional emotions in Gemma 2 9B-IT and Llama 3.1 8B-Instruct, and Shu, Singh, and ElSherief (2026) study Gemma 3 at 4B and 12B, pretrained and tuned. Both read sparse-autoencoder features rather than difference-of-means vectors. Van der Ben et al. ( 2026 ) use the method closest to ours. They test the generality of emotion structure in Gemma-4-E4B-it and Apertus-8B-Instruct-2509, using the 171 emotion concepts from Sofroniew et al. (2026) but with a smaller story corpus and neutral set.
blocks.zh: 最近的一些研究也研究了Gemma模型中的情感表现. Choi和Weber(2026年)表现出Gemma-2-9B和Mistral-7B之间的代表性相似性,尽管他们探测出分类-即时活化而不是取出情感向量. Keeman(2026年)使用有监督的探针和活化补丁,而不是取出矢量,对底部有8个情绪并调制出一对Llama-3.2-1B,Llama-3-8B和Gemma-2-9B. Presa and Teles de Oliveira (2026年)在Gemma 2 9B-IT和Llama 3.1 8B-Instruct中研究组成情感,而Shu, Singh,和El Sherief (2026年)在4B和12B中研究Gemma 3,预训和调制. 两者都读取了稀有的自发编码器特性,而不是不同含义的向量. Van der Ben等人(2026年)使用的方法与我们最接近. 他们测试了Gemma-4-E4B-it和Apertus-8B-Instruct-2509中情感结构的通俗性,使用了来自Sofroniew等(2026年)的171个情感概念,但用更小的故事本体和中性集.

blocks.en: Soligo et al. (2026) study Gemma from the behavioral side, evaluating expressions of distress in the outputs of Gemma 3 at 12B and 27B, base and instruction-tuned, and reducing them with preference optimization. Zhang and Zhong (2025) vary scale and fine-tuning across Qwen3 and Llama-3 and probe six emotions and a neutral class across a Reddit corpus of approximately 400,000 utterances. On scale, their probes separate emotions better in larger models, a result we take up in §5.2. On fine-tuning, they probe a pre-trained model and a fine-tuned variant and find probe accuracy a few points apart, with emotion decodable from the pre-trained models at .69 to .76 (their Table 2). In relation to this study, they compare probe accuracy rather than geometry.
blocks.zh: 索利戈等编. (2026年)从行为方面研究Gemma,评价Gemma 3在12B和27B的输出中表达出危难,基调和指令调制,并用偏好优化来减少. 张同忠(2025年)跨出Qun3和Llama-3,并穿行了大约40万话的Reddituble,探究了6个情感和中性阶层. 在规模上,他们的探测器在更大的模型中能更好地分离出情感,这个结果我们在第5.2节中被采纳. 在微调时,他们探测出一个经过预先训练的模型和一个经过微调的变体,发现探测器精度相差了几分,情绪可以从经过预先训练的模型解码为.69到.76(他们的表2). 与此研究相关,他们比较了探针精确度而不是几何.

blocks.en: Tagliabue, Dung, and Berg (2026) extract a pain direction by difference of means from 25 models, including the six Gemma 2 checkpoints this study uses, and clean it by projecting out the principal components that explain half the variance of their control set. Scoring sentences on the pain direction separates painful sentences from matched controls with AUCs of .87 to 1.00 in every model across their two datasets, and the separation holds about equally from 2B to 72B and in base and tuned models. They measure one direction’s separation, not the geometry of a set of emotion vectors.
blocks.zh: Tagliabue、Dung和Berg(2026年)从25个模型(包括本研究使用的Gemma 2 个检查站)中通过不同手段提取出疼痛方向,并通过预测其控制装置差异的一半的主要部件来清理。 在疼痛方向上分出句子,将痛苦的句子从两个数据集的每个模型中与8.87至1.00的AUC相匹配的控制相分离出,分出的时间在2B至72B之间以及基数和调制模型中均匀. 它们测量一个方向的分离,而不是一组情感向量的几何.

blocks.en: Reichman, Avsian, and Heck (2026) ask the question closest to ours, though they do not test Gemma models. They extract emotion directions from synthetic sentences in base and tuned pairs of LLaMA-3.1-8B and OLMo-2, then ask whether human-written text from eight labeled datasets places the same emotions in the same relative positions. They report that tuned models reproduce the synthetic positions more closely than base models do, and that the distances between neighboring emotions are more distorted in the tuned models. Their one direct base-against-tuned comparison, rank correlations of emotion orderings along the top components, finds the orderings largely preserved under tuning (their Table 7). That finding is consistent in direction with our results in §7.1, though on a smaller emotion set and without a significance test or a pre-set effect size.
blocks.zh: Reichman, Avsian, and Heck (2026) 问的问题与我们最接近,尽管他们不测试Gemma模型. 他们从底部的合成句子中提取出情感取向并调制出LLaMA-3.1-8B和OLMo-2的对子,然后问出8个被标注的数据集中的人文文字是否将相同的情感置于了相同的相对位置. 他们报告说,调制模型比基建模型更紧密地复制了合成位置,相邻情感之间的距离在调制模型中被更扭曲. 他们的一个直接基调对比, 沿着顶端组件排列情感订单的关联, 这个结论与我们在§7.1中的结果一致,尽管是在一个较小的情感集上,没有意义测试或预设效果大小.

blocks.en: No study to date measures emotion geometry across scale and tuning within the Gemma 2 family or across any family with the full pipeline of Sofroniew et al. (2026) . Appendix A sets out the design space and this study’s relationship to its nearest neighbors, none of which combines a base arm, a readout over the model’s whole output vocabulary, and a human-rating benchmark.
blocks.zh: 迄今没有一项研究可以衡量Gemma 2家族内部或任何家族内部的情感几何和调和,而Sofroniew等人(2026年)是全程的。 附 录 A列出了设计空间和本研究与其最近的邻居的关系,这些邻居没有一个结合一个基臂,一个比模型的整个输出词汇读出,以及一个人分等的基准.

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: Following Hollowell (2026) , we reproduce the extraction and characterization pipeline of Sofroniew et al. (2026) , resolving what it leaves unspecified by disclosed rules and changing only the subject models. Six Gemma 2 checkpoints ( Gemma Team , 2024 ) receive identical raw text: google/gemma-2-2b , -2b-it , -9b , -9b-it , -27b , and -27b-it , each pinned to a revision verified at weight-shard level and listed in Appendix I. Scale here names the three released sizes rather than parameter count alone, since the Gemma 2 report trains the 2B and 9B checkpoints by distillation from a larger model and the 27B checkpoint from scratch ( Gemma Team , 2024 ). §9.2 states what that leaves unseparated.
blocks.zh: 继Hollowell(2026年)之后,我们转载了Sofroniew等人(2026年)的取出和定性管道,通过披露的规则解决了它留下的未指明的内容,只改变主题模型. 6个Gemma 2检查站(Gemma Team ,2024年)收到相同的原始文本:google/gemma-2-2b,-2b-it,-9b,-9b-it,-27b;和-27b-it,每个站点被固定在以重量硬度核实并列于附录一的修订版上. 这里的缩放命名了三个已放出大小而非参数单独计数,因为Gemma 2报告通过从更大的模型中分馏来训练出2B和9B检查站,以及从零开始的27B检查站(Gemma Team ,2024. 第9.2节规定了未分离的内容。

blocks.en: Sofroniew et al. (2026) state their layer choice qualitatively (“a particular model layer about two-thirds of the way through the model”) and do not disclose Claude Sonnet 4.5’s layer depth. Gemma 2 2B has 26 transformer layers, and our registered rule, round(2/3 of n_layers), places the replication analysis layer at L17, since two-thirds of 26 is 17.33. Because 17.33 falls between two layers, we also registered L18 as a robustness check. The same rule gives L28 for 9B (42 layers) and L31 for 27B (46 layers).
blocks.zh: Sofroniew等人(2026年)从质量上说明了他们的地层选择(一个特定的模型层,大约是该模型的三分之二),没有披露克洛德·索内4.5的地层深度. Gemma 2 2B有26个变压器层,我们的注册规则为圆(2/3为n_layers)将复制分析层放入L17,因为26的三分之二为17.33. 因为17.33掉入了两层之间,所以我们也注册了L18作为坚固度检查. 同样的规则给予9B(42层)的L28和27B(46层)的L31.

blocks.en: We load each model through TransformerLens 3.3.0 ( Nanda and Bloom, 2022 ) in the raw-weights regime, with no layer-norm folding and no weight centering, so the residual stream and unembedding correspond to the released weights (Appendix J). Extraction runs in bfloat16, following Hollowell (2026) , and reads the post-residual stream at every layer. Gemma 2 applies its RMSNorm in the (1 + w) convention, which the logit-lens readout (§6) handles explicitly rather than through weight folding. In what follows, we define layer 0 as the residual stream after the first transformer block. The embedding table is the static token-embedding lookup, read with no forward pass. Fractional depth is a layer’s index divided by the model’s layer count, so layer 23 of a 46-layer model sits at half depth.
blocks.zh: 我们通过"变形金刚"(FrancherLens 3.3.0 (Nanda and Bloom, 2022))在生重制中加载了每个型号,没有层-正线折叠和重量中心,因此残流和未嵌入对应放出重量(Appendix J). 采掘以bfloat16(英语:bloat16 (2026))进行,并读取每层后遗症流. Gemma 2在(1+w)公约中应用了它的RMSNorm,由logit-lens readout(§6)明确处理而不是通过重量折叠. 接下来,我们定义了第一层变压器块后的残流. 嵌入式表是静态的代号-嵌入式取景,读取时没有前传. 小分层深度是被模型的分层计数所分出的一个地层指数,因此一个46层模型的第23层坐落在了半深度.

blocks.en: Emotion vectors are extracted from a corpus of short stories, each written by Claude Sonnet 4.5 to depict one of 171 emotions from Sofroniew et al. (2026) . The original study did not release its story corpus, so we follow its topic-controlled design: 100 shared scenario topics, each rendered under all 171 emotions, 12 variants per emotion-topic pair, yielding 205,200 stories across 17,100 pairs. All stories were generated by claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 in one uniform regime, and no chat template is applied in any model cell. Confound cleanup uses 500 neutral dialogues generated under the same model and screened for emotional content. See Hollowell (2026) for full pipeline details.
blocks.zh: 情感向量取自一系列短篇小说,每篇由克洛德·索内特(Claude Sonnet 4.5)所写,以描绘出来自Sofroniew等人(2026年)的171个情感之一. 最初的研究没有发布它的故事本体,所以我们遵循它的主题控制设计: 100个共享的情景专题,每个在全部171个情感下提供,每个情感-主题对12个变体,产生205,200个故事,跨越了17,100对. 所有故事都是由Claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929在一个统一的制度下产生的,任何模型单元格都不应用聊天模板. 混乱的清理使用在同一模式下产生的500个中性对话,并筛选出情感内容. 完整的管线细节见Hollowell (2026).

blocks.en: For each Gemma 2 model cell, we extract the emotion vectors following the three steps of Sofroniew et al. (2026) . We pool mean residual-stream activations from the 50th token onward at the analysis layer. We form difference-of-means vectors against the corpus grand mean. We then clean the vectors against the cell’s own neutral-dialogue principal components to 50 percent cumulative variance. The set of components the cleaning removes is the cleanup basis, drawn for each cell from its own dialogues and never shared across cells. The same three steps, run on the embedding-table lookup for each token instead of the residual stream, build the embedding-table vectors of §5.1 with no forward pass. We call what those components carry generic token statistics. Directions that dominate emotionally neutral text most likely encode frequency, length, and formatting, though we did not measure what they contain.
blocks.zh: 对于每一个Gemma 2模型细胞,我们按照Sofroniew等人(2026年)的三个步骤提取出情感向量. 我们池子是指分析层第50个符号的剩余流活化物。 我们组成了区别的载体 与血清的恶性。 然后,我们用细胞本身的中性对话主要成分来清除矢量,以达到50%的累积差异。 清除的一组部件是清理的基础,从每个细胞自己的对话框中抽取,从未在细胞间共享。 相同的三个步骤,运行在每枚令牌的嵌入式表格取出而非剩余流上,构建§5.1的嵌入式表格向量,没有前行通道. 我们称这些组成部分载有通用符号统计。 支配情感中性文字的方向 极有可能编码频率、长度和格式, 尽管我们没有测量它们包含的内容。

blocks.en: Base 27B was extracted again in this pipeline at its analysis layer, L31. Its rerun matched the locked vectors of Hollowell (2026) in 24 of 24 checks, to about 1 × 10 − 9 1\times 10^{-9} . The six rows of Table 1 therefore come from one pipeline, and base 27B’s row is a reproduction of a published measurement rather than a new model.
blocks.zh: 27B基地在其L31分析层的这个管道中再次被取出. 它的重播将24个检查中24个Hollowell(2026)的锁定向量匹配到大约1×10-9 1\times 10×9}. 因此,表1的六行来自一个管道,27B号基地的行是复制已公布的计量,而不是新的模型。

blocks.en: We estimate resampling uncertainty with four procedures and with the seed spread of the clustering. Elsewhere we use analytic Fisher standard errors, permutation tests, and a random-vector null, and we describe each where we use it. Story-level bootstraps draw 1,000 resamples per cell (Table 1 , §4.2). A case bootstrap resamples the 171 emotions, at 2,000 draws, for the layer-stability contrasts of §8.3. A second case bootstrap resamples the 45 rated emotions, at 2,000 draws with the same draw applied to every cell, for the dependence-aware tests of §5.3 and the tuning intervals of §7.1. The same procedure, at 1,000 draws per rating setting, resamples the rated emotions for the emotion-set control of §8.2. Redraws of the cleanup basis repeat the neutral-dialogue draw and the cleaning, at 500 redraws for the readability analyses of §6 and 1,000 for the displacement analysis of §7.4.
blocks.zh: 我们通过四个程序和集群的种子传播来估计不确定性的再现。 在其他地方,我们使用分析费舍尔标准误差, 演化测试, 和随机检测器无效, 我们描述每个使用它的地方。 故事级的靴子每个单元格绘制出1000个复刻图(表1,§4.2). 为第8.3节的分层稳定性对比,以2 000平方英尺的平面重新标出171个情绪。 第二个案例的靴子将45个被标记的情绪重新标出,在2000个图中,每个细胞都应用同样的图,用于第5.3节的依赖意识测试和第7.1节的调试间隔。 同样的程序,每个评分设置取出1000个图,为第8.2节的情绪设定控制重新标出被评分的情绪. 清理基础的再绘制重复了中性对话图和清洁,为第6节的可读性分析重绘了500份,为第7.4节的可读性分析重绘了1,000份。

blocks.en: Registered contrasts are Holm-corrected ( Holm, 1979 ) within three registered families against floors locked before data. The correction holds each family’s smallest p value to a threshold divided by the number of tests in the family, so that running several tests does not raise the chance of a false positive. We registered eleven rows for the tuning family (§7.1), ten for the scale family (§5, with the full battery in Appendix E), and one for the interaction family (§7.1). Rows graded on their floor alone carry no p value and do not count toward the Holm correction. We also registered two vector-norm correlations but designated them exploratory, so they sit outside the families. The tuning battery of §7.1 pools each base-to-tuned difference across the three sizes as the mean of the three per-size differences, a rule fixed at registration before any per-size value was visible, and the per-size differences always print beside the pooled one.
blocks.zh: 登记在册的对比是三个登记家庭的Holm校正(Holm,1979年),与数据前锁起的地板相对应。 校正使每个家庭最小的p值达到一个阈值,除以家庭测试的次数,这样进行几次测试不会增加出现假阳性的机会。 我们登记了11行的调音家庭(第7.1节)、10行的调音家庭(第5节,附录E中的电池全数)和1行的调音家庭(第7.1节)。 单在地上分级的行没有p值,也不算在Holm校正前. 我们还记录了两种矢量与规范的关联性,但指定了它们为探索性,因此它们坐在家庭之外。 §7.1的调试电池将每个基到调试的相差作为每相差3个相差的平均值,在可见任何相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相

Later, in the grading code, we fixed the rows in each family, the endpoint form of the scale contrast, the self-agreement test, and the resampling unit of the layer-stability bootstrap, after extraction and before grading any contrast, with each cell’s own measured values in hand. Appendix C gives the dates and the concordance.
blocks.zh: 在登记时,我们固定了家庭、信号、方向、地板和每种措施的测试。 后来,在分级代码中,我们固定了每个家族的行,比例对比的终点形式,自我一致测试,以及层稳定靴子的再复制单位,在取出后和任何对比分级前,每个单元格自己的测量值都掌握在手. 附 录 C给出了日期和协和.

The .15 floor for correlation contrasts is one Fisher standard error at n = 45, treating the two correlations as independent ( 2 / 42 \sqrt{2/42} = 0.22 in z, about .14 in r near .6), rounded up. The .03 floor for neighbor cosine marks where the registration judged resampling wobble to end, in a bounded metric. The .01 floor for layer stability guards a quantity that reproduces to zero. The 1.0-point floor for variance shares comes from a one-point discrepancy between a caption and a figure in Sofroniew et al. (2026) ( Hollowell, 2026 , §5.1) .

blocks.en: The Fisher tests treat the two correlations they compare as independent, although both are scored against the same emotions, so the .15 and .10 floors are stricter than a dependence-aware test would set. §5.3 reports the two scale contrasts whose verdicts turn on a p value under both standard errors, and every tuning correlation contrast falls below its floor on size alone (§7.1). The pooled tuning test makes a second independence assumption that errs in the opposite direction, treating the three size pairs as independent, and no tuning verdict rests on it (§7.1, §9.2).
blocks.zh: 费舍尔测试将它们比较的两种关联性视为独立,尽管两者都是对同一种情绪的得分,因此15和10层比依赖感测试设定的更严格. 第5.3节报告两个比分对比,其判决在两个标准差值下都显示p值,每个比分的比分都低于其下限(第7.1节)。 集合调制测试给出了第二个独立假设,即错向相反方向,将三对大小对视为独立,而不依赖于调制判断(§7.1,§9.2).

blocks.en: Numbers follow the bounded-quantity convention: correlations, cosines, proportions, agreement indices, and p values cannot exceed 1 in absolute value and carry no leading zero, while unbounded quantities such as variance points and regression coefficients keep theirs. Differences are computed at full precision, so they will not always match the rounded values printed beside them.
blocks.zh: 数字遵循受限数量惯例:相干,相干,比例,协议指数,和p值绝对值不能超过1,不带正零,而相差点和回归系数等未受限数量保持其正零. 差异是完全精确地计算的,因此并不总是与旁边打印的四舍五入值相匹配。

blocks.en: 4 Core emotion geometry
blocks.zh: 页:1 核心情感几何

blocks.en: All six Gemma 2 cells exhibit the core emotion geometry (§4.1). Three cross-cell checks find the geometry closely shared, with differences that stay small (§4.2). A linear map fit between two cells predicts the vectors of emotions it never saw, placing the median held-out emotion nearest its own vector in the target cell (§4.3).
blocks.zh: 所有6个Gemma 2细胞都表现出了核心情感几何(§4.1). 三次跨细胞检查发现几何几何高度紧密相通,而差异仍然很小(§4.2). 两个细胞之间的线性映射会预测它从未见过的情绪的向量,将中位被搁置的情绪最接近它自己的向量放入目标细胞(§4.3).

blocks.en: 4.1 Emotion geometry across six Gemma 2 models
blocks.zh: 4.1 跨越6个Gemma 2模型的情感几何

blocks.en: In each cell we fit principal components on all 171 cleaned vectors, then correlate each emotion’s position on the first two components with human ratings of valence and arousal for the 45 rated emotions from Russell and Mehrabian (1977) . The first component, PC1, captures 26.7 to 31.9 percent of the vectors’ variance across the six cells (Table 1 ), against about 27 percent in Claude Sonnet 4.5 ( Sofroniew et al., 2026 ) . PC1 tracks valence in every cell, with correlations of .711 to .777 against .81 for Claude Sonnet 4.5. The Claude Sonnet 4.5 values here and below are reference points, not comparisons. The registration tested no difference from them.
blocks.zh: 在每一个细胞中,我们把主要成分放在所有171个被清理的载体上,然后将每种情感在前两个成分上的位置与人类对Russell和Mehrabian(1977年)的45个被评级的情绪的英勇和激动程度联系起来。 第一部分PC1记录了6个细胞的矢量差异(表1)的26.7%至31.9%,而克洛德·索内4.5(Sofroniew等,2026年)的矢量差异约为27%。 PC1追踪每个细胞的活性,其相关性为克洛德·索内 4.5对0.81. Claude Sonnet 4.5 值在这里和下面是参考点,而不是比较. 登记结果与它们没有区别。

blocks.en: The second component, PC2, captures 12.7 to 13.9 percent of the variance, against about 14 percent in Claude Sonnet 4.5, and tracks arousal, with correlations of .363 to .668 against .66 for Claude Sonnet 4.5. Both axes are significant by permutation in every cell (p ≤ \leq .02 over 5,000 shuffles). The arousal correlation is weaker than the valence correlation in every Gemma 2 cell, as Hollowell (2026) observed for base 27B, and varies more between cells. Every cell therefore passes the test §1 set, which asks that both axes be significant and that arousal be the weaker.
blocks.zh: 第二部分PC2捕捉了12.7%至13.9%的差异,而克洛德·索内4.5中的这一比例约为14%,并追踪了轰动,克洛德·索内4.5的相对比为363至66. 两个轴都通过每个单元格的穿透而显著(p \\leq.02 超过5,000 shuffles). 如霍洛韦尔(2026年)观察到的基数27B,每个Gemma 2细胞的活性相关比活性相关更弱,并且细胞间差异更大. 因此,每个细胞都会通过第1节的测试集,这要求两个轴都具有显著性,而激发是弱者.

blocks.en: Table 1: Core emotion geometry in the six Gemma 2 cells. The ± \pm after each variance share and correlation is the standard deviation across 1,000 story-level bootstrap resamples, with each cell’s cleanup basis held fixed. Self-agreement’s ± \pm is the standard deviation across 20 clustering seeds. Cohesion carries none, because it was registered with a direction but no test.
blocks.zh: 表1:六格玛2细胞中的核心情感几何. 每个差异分享和关联后的 ±\pm 是1000 个故事级的靴子重印的标准偏差, 并且每个单元格的清理基础被固定 。 自协议的±\pm是20个集群种子的标准偏差. 凝聚是没有的,因为它被注册了方向,但没有测试。

blocks.en: Following Sofroniew et al. (2026) , we also sort the 171 vectors into ten families with k-means and score each partition for cohesion and self-agreement. For each emotion we count how many of its ten nearest cosine neighbors fall inside its own family, and we average that fraction over the 171 emotions. Cohesion runs .706 to .758 across the six cells (Table 1 ), so between seven and eight of an emotion’s ten nearest neighbors share its family. Self-agreement is how closely partitions of the same cell from different random seeds agree, measured by the average adjusted Rand index between them (§4.2), where 1 means the partitions are identical. Self-agreement runs .656 to .717 across the six cells (Table 1 ). Together the two scores describe soft but stable families, in which neighbors mostly stay together while the boundaries between families shift from seed to seed. Cohesion and self-agreement fall in narrow ranges, and base 27B’s values sit within both. The registration predicted their direction but set no floor or pass criterion for them, so they describe the cells rather than grade them.
blocks.zh: 继Sofroniew等人(2026年)之后,我们还将171个向量分类为10个有k-意指的家庭,并得分每个分区,以达到凝聚力和自我一致. 对于每一种情感,我们计算出10个最接近的相声邻居中有多少人 落入了他们自己的家庭,我们平均比171个情感小。 凝聚在6个细胞(表1)之间, 自约定是同一个细胞从不同的随机种子中如何紧密地分出,以它们之间平均调整的Rand指数(§4.2)来测量,其中1表示分出是相同的. 自行协议横跨了6个单元格(表1),为656至717个。 这两个分数加在一起说明了软而稳定的家庭,其中邻居大多呆在一起,而家庭之间的界限则从种子转移到种子。 团结和自我协议在狭义范围内落到地上,而基础27B的价值在两者之中。 注册者预测了他们的方向,但没有为他们设定下限或通过标准,因此他们描述的是细胞,而不是分级.

blocks.en: 4.2 Cross-cell checks
blocks.zh: 4.2 跨细胞检查

blocks.en: With emotion geometry established in each cell, we ask how closely the cells match one another at three levels: the pairwise similarities among the 171 emotion vectors, the plane of the two leading axes, and the partition of the emotions into ten families.
blocks.zh: 随着情感几何在每一个细胞中建立起来,我们询问细胞在三个层次上如何紧密相匹配:171个情感向量之间的对等相近性,两个主轴的平面,以及情感被分入十个家庭.

blocks.en: Pairwise similarities
blocks.zh: 对等相似性

blocks.en:
Within each cell, the cosines between every pair of the 171 emotion vectors form a 171-by-171 table. We score how closely two cells’ tables agree by the cosine between their entries, following representational similarity analysis ( Kriegeskorte, Mur, and
Bandettini, 2008 ) , where 1 means identical. We make nine comparisons, the three tuning pairs (base and tuned at one size) and the six scale pairs (two sizes at one tuning level). A score below 1 could reflect a difference between the cells or only the sampling of their stories, so we also score how well each cell agrees with itself. For each emotion we resample its own 1,200 stories with replacement and recompute all 171 vectors from stored activations, which gives one replicate of the cell. We draw 1,000 replicates per cell, pair them into 500 pairs, and score each pair.
blocks.zh:
在每个细胞内,171个情感向量的每对相间相间相间形成171-by-171表. 我们根据代表性相似性分析(Kriegeskorte、Mur和

blocks.en: PC1 and PC2 planes
blocks.zh: PC1和PC2飞机

blocks.en: Each cell’s first two components, PC1 (valence) and PC2 (arousal), give each emotion a position in a plane. To compare two cells’ planes, we rotate one cell’s positions to fit the other’s as closely as possible by orthogonal Procrustes alignment ( Schönemann, 1966 ) , which Ding et al. (2021) find performs well for comparing models. The disparity is the mismatch left after the best rotation, and it is zero for planes identical up to rotation. Aligning the two replicates in each of the same 500 pairs gives the within-cell reference.
blocks.zh: 每个细胞的前两个组件,即PC1(价值)和PC2(激动),给每个情感在平面上一个位置. 为了比较两个细胞的平面,我们将一个细胞的位置旋转,以尽可能地通过正交的蛋白质对接(Schönemann,1966年)来配合另一个细胞的位置,Ding等人(2021年)认为这在比较模型方面表现良好。 差异是最佳旋转后留下的不匹配,对于与旋转相仿的飞机来说是零. 在同一500对中,将两个复制体对齐,给出细胞内参考.

blocks.en: In every cell 95 percent of the replicate pairs align at a disparity of .0070 or less. Eight of the nine comparisons exceed .0070, with disparities of .016 to .049. The ninth, 9B tuned against 27B tuned, sits at .0048, within the replicate range. The best-fitting rotation never exceeds 2.2 degrees, and no alignment needs a reflection, which would mean one plane is a mirror image of the other. Across all nine comparisons, then, the two cells’ planes line up almost without rotation, and the differences that remain lie in where individual emotions sit, not in how the axes are oriented. §9.1 explains how a plane this stable can coexist with a weaker, more variable arousal axis.

blocks.en: 4.3 Cross-cell prediction
blocks.zh: 4.3 跨细胞预测

blocks.en: We now ask whether an emotion’s vector in one cell can be recovered from the same emotion’s vector in another. We use a Procrustes alignment between cells, which we call transport for short, and fit one linear map per pair of cells to predict each emotion’s target vector from its source vector. The cells differ in width, 2,304 coordinates at 2B, 3,584 at 9B, and 4,608 at 27B, so their vectors cannot be compared directly. The map is deliberately rigid, a semi-orthogonal Procrustes map plus one global scale ( Schönemann, 1966 ) . It applies one rotation, possibly with a reflection, and one rescaling to the whole set of vectors, with no stretch along any single direction and no shear. When the target is at least as wide as the source, the map preserves every angle among the vectors and scales every distance by one common factor. When the target is narrower, the map projects the vectors into the smaller space, which shrinks those distances.
blocks.zh: 我们现在问一个细胞中的情绪载体是否能够从另一个细胞中的同一情绪载体中恢复出来。 我们使用一个细胞间的Procrustes对齐,我们称之为短程迁移,并安装了每对细胞的一对线性图来预测每种情绪的目标向量的源向量. 细胞的宽度不同,2,304坐标为2B,3,584坐标为9B,4,608坐标为27B,因此它们的向量无法被直接比较. 地图刻意僵硬,为半正弦Procrustes地图外加一全球尺度(Schönemann,1966.). 它采用一回转,可能带有反射,并用一回缩放来整组向量,没有沿着任何单一方向伸展,也没有剪接. 当目标至少和源一样宽时,地图会用一个共同因素来保存向量和相距的每个角度. 当目标更窄时,地图会将矢量投射入更小的空间,从而缩小了这些距离.

blocks.en: We split the 171 emotions at random into five groups and fit each map five times. Each fit uses four groups, 136 or 137 emotions, and predicts the fifth, so every emotion is predicted once by a map fit without it. We score each prediction by the rank of the emotion’s own vector among all 171 target vectors, including those the map was fit on. Rank 1 means the nearest target vector is the emotion’s own, and the top-1 rate is the share of held-out emotions at rank 1. Held-out retrieval under a fitted map is the standard test in cross-lingual embedding alignment ( Smith et al., 2017 ) . The map has no setting for any single emotion, so a prediction reaches rank 1 only when the two cells arrange the emotions largely alike. Because each map is fit only on emotion vectors, transport concerns the subspace they span, not the full representation space of either cell.
blocks.zh: 我们随机地把171个情感分成了5组,每张地图5次合拍. 每个配体都使用四个组,136或137个情感,并预测了第五个,所以每个情感都通过一个配体没有它的地图来预测一次. 在171个目标矢量中, 包括地图上的矢量。 排名1意味着最接近的目标矢量是情感本身,而最高的一分是排行榜上被搁置的情绪的份额. 1. 联合国 所安装的地图下的挂出检索是跨语言嵌入式对齐的标准测试(Smith等,2017.). 地图没有设置任何单一的情感,所以只有当两个细胞大致相同地安排情绪时,预测才达到一级. 因为每张地图只适合情感向量,所以迁移涉及它们所跨越的子空间,而不是两个单元格的完整代表空间.

blocks.en: We designated one pair as the primary transport test before running, 2B base to 27B base, the grid’s largest jump in scale and a doubling of width. The pass bar was fixed at the same time: for the primary pair, a median rank of at most 2 across all 171 predictions and a permutation p below .001. Every held-out emotion lands nearest its own vector from 2B base to 27B base, a top-1 rate of 1.0, and the median cosine between a mapped vector and its own target vector is .972. For the null we shuffled which target vector belongs to which emotion, refit, and scored top-1 accuracy, 10,000 times. No shuffle matched the observed score, which puts the add-one p at its smallest possible value, 9.999 × 10 − 5 9.999\times 10^{-5} .

blocks.en: A pre-stated exploratory analysis asks whether transport depends on the two cells seeing the same stories. We split the 100 story topics into two fixed sets of 50 and built source vectors from one set and target vectors from the other, and all 32 cross-cell fits meet the median-rank criterion (Appendix D). A bag-of-words baseline with no fitted map retrieves as well on the same partition, at top-1 .877 and .883 in the two directions, unchanged when single-word emotion names are removed. Lexical information alone is therefore sufficient for strong performance on this retrieval task, which limits what transport can be read as showing.

blocks.en: 5 Embedding tables and scale effects
blocks.zh: 页:1 嵌入式表格和比例效应

blocks.en: This section asks how much of the core emotion geometry is already present in the token-embedding table, before any layer runs, and how scale changes the geometry’s shape. Embedding-table vectors correlate moderately with human ratings of valence and weakly with arousal in every cell (§5.1). Linear maps that recover held-out emotions at median rank 1 at 2 / 3 \nicefrac{{2}}{{3}} depth (§4.3), refit on embedding-table vectors, recover them at median rank 1 there too. Scale spreads the geometry’s variance across more components without weakening the leading component’s tie to valence (§5.2). The arousal correlation rises from 2B to 27B, and so does the gap between the arousal correlation at the embedding table and at the analysis layer. Neither rise passes its registered test, and both depend on whether the 2B cells are read at L17, their analysis layer, or at L18, the registered alternative (§5.3).
blocks.zh: 本节询问,在任何地层运行之前,代号-嵌入式表格中已经存在了多少核心情感几何,尺度如何改变几何形状. 嵌入式可移动载体与人类对活性的评价有中度关联,与每个细胞的振荡度有微弱关联(第5.1节)。 线性地图在2 / 3 / nicefrac \2 + 3 / 深度(§4.3)中恢复被搁置的情绪, 在嵌入式表矢量上重现, 在中位数1那里也恢复。 缩放将几何体的相差分散到更多的组件,而不会削弱主要组件与等值的结合(§5.2). 催生相关从2B上升至27B,嵌入表和分析层的催生相关差距也随之上升. 上升均不通过注册测试,两者都取决于2B细胞在L17即其分析层被读取,还是在L18即注册替代品被读取(§5.3)。

blocks.en: 5.1 Embedding tables track valence more than arousal
blocks.zh: 5.1 联合国 嵌入的表 轨道的活性比振奋

blocks.en: Hollowell (2026) introduced an embedding-table baseline that builds emotion vectors from the embedding table of base Gemma 2 27B and compares them with the vectors at the 2 / 3 \nicefrac{{2}}{{3}} -depth analysis layer. We repeat that baseline across all six cells to measure how much of the emotion geometry each model’s embedding table carries before any layer runs.
blocks.zh: Hollowell(2026年)引入了嵌入式表基线,从基座Gemma 2 27B的嵌入表构建出情感向量,并在2 / 3\nicefrac *============= - 深入分析层。 我们重复这六个细胞的基线, 用来测量每个模型嵌入表的情感几何中 有多少在任何层流出之前。

blocks.en: For each story we average the embedding-table vectors over every token from the 50th onward (§3). From those averages we build one difference-of-means vector per emotion and clean it against the neutral dialogues’ own embeddings, removing their top three principal components, which carry half their variance in every cell. No forward pass runs at any point. We locked this analysis at registration, and for base 27B it reproduces the published baseline values exactly.
blocks.zh: 对于每个故事,我们平均从第50个开始,每个信使的嵌入式向量(§3). 从这些平均值来看,我们构建了一种每分情感的差分矢量,并用中性对话本身的嵌入来清理它,去除它们最大的三个主要部分,它们在每个细胞中都有一半的差异。 任何前方通行证都无法通过。 我们把这个分析锁定在注册时, 对于基准27B, 它完全复制了公布的基准值。

blocks.en: In all six cells, the embedding table correlates moderately with human valence ratings (r = .479 to .507, all p < .001) and weakly with arousal ratings (r = .125 to .179, all p ≥ \geq .24, none significant). Vectors from each cell’s analysis layer correlate more strongly with both (valence r = .711 to .777, arousal r = .363 to .668, Table 1 ). From the embedding table to the analysis layer, the valence correlation rises by .21 to .29 within each cell and the arousal correlation by .24 to .49. The valence correlation is thus moderate before any layer runs, while the arousal correlation is weak.
blocks.zh: 在所有6个单元格中,嵌入表与人类的值评级(r = 479至507,均为p < 001)有中度关联,与刺激评级(r =.125至179,均为p =\ geq 24,无显著值)有微弱关系。 每个细胞分析层的矢量与两者关系更密切(数值为r=711至777;激发值为r=363至668,表1)。 从嵌入表到分析层,每个单元格内的等价相关率上升了21至29,而激发相关率上升了24至.49。 因此,在任何地层运行之前,活性相关是中性的,而活性相关是弱的.

blocks.en: Because cleaning removes generic token statistics (§3), we also compare raw and cleaned vectors, as Hollowell (2026) did for base 27B. On raw vectors the valence correlation is near zero at 2B and 9B (.029 to .074), which suggests that generic token statistics dominate the first component. In those cells the valence correlation emerges only on cleaned vectors. In the 27B cells the valence correlation is substantial on raw vectors as well (.378 and .380), possibly because the generic directions are proportionally weaker there or because the table puts proportionally more of its variance on valence. This study does not test which.
blocks.zh: 因为打扫可以去除通用的代号统计(§3),我们还比较了原始和被清洗的矢量,就像霍洛韦尔(2026)对基础27B所做的那样. 在原始矢量上,2B和9B(.029至.074)的等价关系接近于零,这表明通用符号统计在第一个部分占主导地位. 在这些细胞中,只有被清理的载体才会出现能量关联。 在27B细胞中,对原始矢量的活性相关度也很大(378和380),这可能是因为通用方向在比例上较弱,或者因为表格在活性上将其相差较大。 这项研究没有检验哪个。

blocks.en: Cleaning does not simply inflate correlations, however. It lowers the arousal correlation in every cell, from .193 to .325 raw to .125 to .179 cleaned. Table gives raw and cleaned values for every cell. Whether the analysis layer’s valence axis is the table’s own direction carried forward, or a different direction that tracks the same ratings, this study does not measure (§10).
blocks.zh: 然而,清洁工作并非只是夸大了相互关系。 它会降低每个细胞的激发相关性,从生的193个降低到被清理的325个到被清理的.125个到179个. 表格给出每个单元格的原始和清洁值。 无论分析层的活率轴是表格自己前进的方向,还是跟踪相同收视率的不同方向,本研究并不衡量(§10).

blocks.en: Emotion geometry beyond the valence correlation is present at the embedding table. In an unregistered check, we refit the linear maps of §4.3 on the cleaned embedding-table vectors, for every pair of cells in both directions. Every fit kept median rank 1, and in every fit each held-out emotion landed nearest its own vector. Median cosines ran lower in every pair, .943 to .958 against .969 to .982 at the analysis layer, a gap of .02 to .03 with no uncertainty computed. The arrangement of emotions that one model’s table shares with another’s is present before the first layer runs.
blocks.zh: 在嵌入式表格中,存在超出等价相关性的情感几何. 在一次未注册的检查中,我们重新绘制了第4.3节的线性图,显示清理后的嵌入式向量,每对双向细胞都使用。 每一个合适的都保持了中位数1, 在每一个合适的中, 每一个被搁置的情绪 降落在自己最近的载体。 在分析层,每对相差943至958分而相差969至982分而相差0.02至.03分而无不确定性。 一个模型的表与另一个模型的表所分享的情感安排在第一层运行之前就已经存在了.

blocks.en: 5.2 Scale spreads component variance
blocks.zh: 5.2 国家 缩放分布组件差异

blocks.en: To understand how scale changes the shape of the emotion geometry, we compare the share of variance on the first component across six cells. We registered a prediction that PC1’s share of variance (Table 1 ) would rise modestly from 2B to 27B, and its test, fixed at grading (§3), compares the 2B and 27B endpoints against a floor of 1.0 point. This renders the 9B shares descriptive. (Table records a second registered clause on this prediction, never graded.)
blocks.zh: 为了了解尺度如何改变情感几何的形状,我们比较了第一个元件在6个细胞上的差异比例. 我们预测PC1在差异中的份额(表1)将从2B小幅上升至27B小幅,其测试定在分级(§3),将2B和27B的终点比作1.0分的下限。 这使得9B股成为描述. (表格记录了这一预测的第二个登记条款,从未分级。 )

blocks.en: In the base chain, PC1’s share falls from 31.62 percent at 2B to 29.85 at 9B to 26.73 at 27B (Figure 3 ). In the tuned chain it falls from 31.89 to 29.16 to 27.27. The drop from base 2B to 27B is 4.88 percentage points, and the drop from tuned 2B to 27B is 4.62 percentage points, opposite to our prediction. Each chain’s drop exceeds the floor more than fourfold and sits about 39 bootstrap standard errors from zero (38.6 and 39.4). Both are Holm-significant at p < 10 − 15 10^{-15} , reported as a bound (Table ).
blocks.zh: 在基础链中,PC1的份额从2B的31.62%下降到9B的29.85,再下降到27B的26.73(图3)。 在调音链中,从31.89降至29.16至27.27. 从基数2B降至27B为4.88个百分点,从调取2B降至27B为4.62个百分点,与我们的预测相反. 每条链子的下降超过地上4倍多,并坐落着从零(38.6和39.4)起的约39个靴子标准误差. 两者均是 " Holm -- -- 重大 " ,载于 " p < 10 - 15 10 -- -- 15 " ,报告为一个约束(表)。

blocks.en: The drop is not an artifact of the cleanup. On raw vectors PC1’s share still falls from 2B to 27B, by 4.8 points in the base chain and 5.5 in the tuned chain. On both raw and cleaned vectors, larger models put a smaller share of their emotion variance on the first principal component.
blocks.zh: 滴不是清理的文物. 在原始矢量上,PC1的股份仍然从2B下降到27B,在基链上下降了4.8分,在调制链上下降了5.5分. 在生的和被清理的向量上,较大的模型将其情感差异中较小的一部分放在了第一个主元件上.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Component variance and dimension estimates across checkpoint sizes. Panel (a) shows PC1’s share of variance in each cell. Panel (b) shows two unregistered measures of effective dimension, the participation ratio and TwoNN. The TwoNN point estimates are similar across cells, but no uncertainty was computed for them.
blocks.zh: 图3:各检查站规模的构成部分差异和尺寸估计数。 (a) 小组显示PC1在每个单元格中的差异份额。 小组(b)显示两项未登记的有效衡量标准,即参与比率和 " 双网 " 。 TwoNN点估计在细胞间类似,但没有计算出它们的不确定性.

blocks.en: As PC1’s share of variance falls, we track the participation ratio, which counts how many linear directions effectively share the variance. (If one component carried all the variance, the ratio would be 1, and if k components shared it equally, it would be k.) Here it rises with scale in both chains, from 6.90 to 7.34 to 8.39 in the base chain and from 6.88 to 7.61 to 8.27 in the tuned chain (Figure 3b). So as PC1’s share falls, the variance is behaving as if spread over about one and a half additional components.
blocks.zh: 随着PC1差异份额的下降,我们追踪参与比率,这算上有多少线性方向能有效分享差异。 (如果有一个部分包含所有差异,则比率为1;如果k部分平等分享,则比率为k.) 其规模随两个链条而上升,从基链的6.90起至7.34起至8.39起,从调制链的6.88起至7.61起至8.27起(图3b). 因此,随着PC1份额的下降,这一差异似乎分散在大约一个半额外组件上。

blocks.en: TwoNN ( Facco et al., 2017 ) estimates intrinsic dimension, the number of dimensions a point cloud locally spans, from each point’s distances to its two nearest neighbors. For each cell’s 171 vectors, TwoNN is about 4.3 (Figure 3b), so the vectors locally span about four dimensions at every size. Larger models therefore spread their emotion variance across more linear directions, while the local dimension of the vectors barely changes. Both are unregistered checks for which no uncertainty was computed.
blocks.zh: TwoNN(Facco等,2017年)估算出内在维度,一点云的维度数局部跨度,从每个点的相距到相距最近的两个相邻. 对于每个单元格的171个向量,TwoNN大约为4.3(图3b),因此,向量在局部上大约跨越了每个大小的4个维. 因此,更大的模型将情绪差异分散到更线性的方向,而矢量的局部维度几乎没有变化. 两者均为未登记的检查,没有计算不确定性。

blocks.en: A second registered contrast asks whether PC1’s correlation with valence ratings changes from 2B to 27B, against a floor of .15. It does not. The correlation is .71 at 2B and .72 at 27B in the base chain, and .76 at 2B and .77 at 27B in the tuned chain (p = .928 and .927). A summary built on PC1 alone therefore describes less of a larger model’s emotion variance, though PC1 itself is about as strongly correlated with valence at every size.
blocks.zh: 第二个注册对比则询问PC1与valence收视率的相关性是否从2B变为27B,而下限为:15. 它没有。 其相关性为:基链中2B分为.71;基链中27B分为.72;被调链中2B分为.76;被调链中27B分为.77 (p=928和927). 因此,仅仅基于PC1的总结就较少描述一个更大的模型的情感差异,尽管PC1本身与各种大小的活性有着同样强烈的关联.

blocks.en: Finally, a smaller share of variance on PC1 leaves open whether larger models represent emotions less distinctly or only distribute them across more directions. Zhang and Zhong (2025) find that probes separate emotions better in larger Qwen3 and Llama-3 models, so we asked whether separability holds in this family. An unregistered nearest-class-mean classifier on held-out stories from our corpus picks the right emotion among the 171 about equally well at every scale (Appendix A). Larger models thus represent emotions no less distinctly, only across more directions. §10 names an approach to identifying which distinctions among emotions those added directions carry.
blocks.zh: 最后,PC1上差异的一小部分留了空,无论较大的模型代表的情绪不太明显,还是只分布在更远的方向上. 张和曾(2025年)发现,在更大的Qune3和Llama-3模型中,探针将情感分离得更好,所以我们问分解是否在这个家族中存在. 一个未注册的离我们最近阶级的分类员, 记录我们被搁置的故事, 因此,较大的模型代表的情感并不那么明显,只是跨越更多的方向。 §10列出了一种方法,用以确定这些新增方向的情感之间的区别。

blocks.en: 5.3 Scale may strengthen arousal
blocks.zh: 5.3 联合国 缩放可能增强

blocks.en: We use two measures to follow arousal across scale. The first measure, arousal tracking, is the correlation of PC2 positions with human arousal ratings (Table 1 ). Its registered test is a Fisher z comparison of the 2B and 27B endpoints within a chain, with a registered floor of .15. From 2B to 27B, arousal tracking rises by +.168 in the base chain and +.215 in the tuned chain, above the floor in both, and the test passes in neither (p = .237 and .200). The arousal axis gets better at ordering emotions by arousal as the model gets bigger, but not with enough certainty to count as a finding.
blocks.zh: 我们采取了两项措施,以全面贯彻。 第一项措施是催生跟踪,即PC2职位与人类催生收视率的关联性(表1). 它的注册测试是将链内2B和27B端点的Fisher z比较,注册下层为:. 从2B到27B,催生跟踪在基链中上升了+168,在调制链中上升了+215,在两侧都高于地层,测试在两侧都没有通过(p=237和.200). 随着模型变大,振动轴更能通过振动命令情绪,但没有足够的确定性可以算作发现.

blocks.en: The second measure is the rise in the arousal correlation from the embedding table to the analysis layer, measured here in Fisher z units. We call this the depth gap. It has no registered floor, and its registered test is the same endpoint comparison as arousal tracking. From 2B to 27B the depth gap grows by +.203 in the base chain and +.229 in the tuned chain, and the test passes in neither (p = .511 and .459). As with arousal tracking, it moves in the registered direction without passing the registered test, so we report both results as leads rather than findings.
blocks.zh: 第二个尺度是从嵌入表到分析层的激发相关性上升,用Fisher z单位测量。 我们称之为深度差距。 它没有注册楼层,其注册测试与催眠跟踪是相同的端点比较. 从2B到27B,深度差距由基链的+.203和调制链的+.229增大而来,而测试则不通过(p = 511和 4.59). 与催眠跟踪一样,它向注册方向移动,但没有通过注册测试,因此我们把两种结果都作为线索而不是结果报告。

blocks.en: An unregistered bootstrap shows that the Fisher tests understate the evidence for both measures. The Fisher tests treat the correlations they compare as independent, although every correlation is scored against the same 45 rated emotions (§3). The bootstrap resamples those 45 emotions once per round and recomputes every correlation on that same resample. The bootstrap’s standard errors are 22 to 27 percent the size of the Fisher standard errors, so the Fisher tests are roughly four times too conservative here. Under the bootstrap, arousal tracking rises with p = 1.1 × 10 − 5 1.1\times 10^{-5} in the base chain and 1.3 × 10 − 6 1.3\times 10^{-6} in the tuned chain, and the depth gap grows with p = .003 and .001. Because the bootstrap was not registered, both measures remain not established and not shown absent. The bootstrap also resamples a selected set, the 45 emotions Russell and Mehrabian rated, rather than a random sample from a defined population. Its p values therefore show that both rises hold across those 45 emotions, not that they extend to emotions outside them. Story-level standard deviations in each cell’s arousal correlation run only .009 to .023 (Table 1 ), so the 45 rated emotions, not the story sample, set the limit on every test against ratings. Under the two broader rating sets of §8.1, which cover most of the 171 emotions, the rise is smaller (Table ).
blocks.zh: 一个未注册的靴子显示,Fisher测试低估了这两种措施的证据。 费舍尔测试将它们比较的关联性视为独立,虽然每个关联性都与同45个被评级的情感(§3)作对. 靴子重新标出45个情绪 每回合一次, 并重新计算 每一个关联 在同一重新标出。 靴子的标准误差是费舍尔标准误差的22%至27%,因此费舍尔测试大约是这里保守的四倍。 在靴子下,催生跟踪在基链中上升为p=1.1×10-5 1.1\times 10×5}在调制链中上升为1.3×10-6 1.3\times 10×6],深度差距以p=003和.001增长. 由于没有登记靴子,这两项措施仍然没有确立,也没有显示不存在。 靴子还重新标出一个被选中的集,45个情感罗素和梅赫拉比安被评分,而不是来自一个被定义的人群的随机样本. 因此,它的p值表明,这两种情绪的上升都贯穿于这45种情绪之间,而不是它们延伸到它们以外的情绪。 故事层标准偏差在每个细胞的激发相关性中只运行了.009到.023(表1),因此45个被评分的情感,而不是故事样本,对每次测试的评分设定了限制. 在涵盖171个情感的大部分的两套更宽泛的评级中,上升幅度较小(表)。

blocks.en: Because 2B’s analysis layer is L17, rounded from 17.33, we ran analyses at L18 as a robustness check (§3). Here that check is instructive, because on 2B base the arousal correlation is .499 at L17 and .656 at L18, a move of .157 that spans almost the whole of the +.168 rise the base chain shows from 2B to 27B. Reading 2B at L18, arousal tracking rises by only +.012 in the base chain and +.119 in the tuned chain, both below the .15 floor, and the same Fisher test is not significant in either chain (p = .92 and .45). Similarly, on 2B L18 the depth gap reverses sign in the base chain, from +.203 to − - .034, and falls from +.229 to +.113 in the tuned chain. Under the bootstrap, the base chain’s rise loses its support (p = .50) and the tuned chain’s rise keeps its support (p = .0004), and the depth gap has p = .55 and .08. These checks do not re-grade the results from L17, but they flag that a scale contrast read at one layer per cell can turn on a one-layer rounding choice. For this reason, §10 proposes scoring arousal over a depth band rather than at a single layer.
blocks.zh: 由于2B的分析层为L17,从17.33入围,我们在L18进行了分析,作为坚固度检查(§3). 这里的检查很有启发性,因为在2B基上,激发相关性在L17为499个,在L18为656个,一个几乎跨越+168整个基链的.157的移动显示从2B升至27B. 在L18读取2B时,催生跟踪在基链上只上升了+.012,在调制链上则上升了+.119,两者都低于0.15层,同样的Fisher测试在两个链上都不显著(p=.92和.45). 同样地,在2B L18上,深度差距倒转了基链中的标志,从+.203到−-.034,再从调制链中的+.229下降到+.113. 在靴子下,基链起伏失去支持(p =.50),而调制链起伏保持支持(p =.0004),深度差距有p =.55和.08. 这些检查不会对L17的结果进行再分级,但它们会标出一个比例对比,每个单元格一个层次读取,可以打开一个一层次的圆形选择. 因此,第10节建议在深度波段上而不是在一地层上打分。

blocks.en: 6 Readability across scale
blocks.zh: 6 整个规模的可读性

blocks.en: Hollowell (2026) found that emotion vectors in Gemma 2 27B base become readable in the output vocabulary at half depth. This section establishes the readout instrument (§6.1) and asks when each cell’s emotion words become readable (§6.2). In the 2B and 9B cells the median emotion word reads from layer 0, while in the 27B cells it stays unreadable until layer 23, half depth. The 27B geometry consolidates at that same layer, and the two coincide where readability begins, at the top-10,000 line, but not under stricter readability lines (§6.3).
blocks.zh: Hollowell (2026)发现,Gemma 2 27B基中的情感向量在输出词汇中半深可读. 本节设定了读出器(§6.1)并询问每个单元格的情感词何时可以读取(§6.2). 在2B和9B细胞中,中位情感字从第0层读取,而在第27B细胞中,它一直无法读取,直到第23层半深. 27B几何在同一层进行整合,可读性开始的两个重合点在前一万行,但不在更严格的可读性行下(§6.3).

blocks.en: 6.1 The readout instrument
blocks.zh: 6.1 请检查date=中的日期值 (帮助) 读取器

blocks.en: Sofroniew et al. (2026, Table 1) use a vocabulary projection, the logit lens ( nostalgebraist, 2020 ) , to multiply an emotion vector by the model’s unembedding matrix and read the highest-ranking tokens for twelve emotions: happy, inspired, loving, proud, calm, desperate, angry, guilty, sad, afraid, nervous, surprised. Hollowell (2026, §7.1 to §7.2) repeats the projection on Gemma 2 27B base and multiplies the cleaned vectors by the unembedding matrix alone, without the model’s final normalization, since the normalized lens expects a residual state rather than a difference-of-means vector.
blocks.zh: Sofroniew等 (2026,表1)使用词汇投影法,logit透镜(Nostalgebraist, 2020),用模型的未嵌入矩阵来乘以一个情感向量,并读取十二个情感的最高级别的代号:快乐,灵感,相爱,骄傲,冷静,绝望,愤怒,有罪,悲伤,恐惧,紧张,惊讶. Hollowell(2026,§7.1至§7.2)重复了对Gemma 2 27B基座的投影,并将被清理的向量由未嵌入的矩阵单独相乘而成,没有模型的最终正常化,因为正态镜头期望的是剩余状态,而不是表示差的向量.

blocks.en: We extend this analysis to all six cells. We grade the vocabulary projection for the same twelve emotions under one rubric fixed before the data existed, which counts an emotion as on-theme when at least two of its top five tokens are emotion-related. A fresh-context Claude session read the rubric and each cell’s top five tokens, with the rows in random order, and scored every row. We used its verdicts as returned, without regrading. To illustrate, Table 2 shows the guilty row in each cell.
blocks.zh: 我们把这一分析扩大到所有六个单元。 在数据存在之前,我们用一个固定的词组来对同样的12个情感进行词汇投射, 当它前五个符号中至少有两个与情感有关的时候,这个词组将一种情感算作主题。 一个全新的 Claude 会话读出标题和每个单元格的前五个符号, 各行按随机顺序排列, 每行得分 。 我们用它的判决作为回报,没有重新评级。 举例来说,表2显示每个牢房的有罪行。

blocks.en: Table 2: Guilty’s top five promoted tokens in each cell. Asterisks mark tokens the grader judged emotion-related. Leading spaces are part of the token.
blocks.zh: 表2:每个牢房中有罪前五名的标志。 Asterisks标记了 与情感有关的校友判断符号 领先空间是象征的一部分。

blocks.en: Between seven and eleven of the twelve emotions grade on-theme in every cell (Table 3 ). Four read on-theme in all six cells and nine in at least five, while guilty and calm set the floor, each for a different reason. As Table 2 shows for 27B base, guilty promotes the word guilt itself, but the other four of its top five are unrelated word fragments and tokens from other languages. Calm’s top tokens are generically positive, which the rubric discounts for sharing an emotion’s valence without naming it. These tallies are integer counts on a twelve-item rubric, and the section carries forward the family-wide claim, not any single cell’s tally.
blocks.zh: 每个细胞中12个情感等级中的7到11个主题(表3. 4个在全部6个囚室中按主题读取,9个在至少5个囚室中读取,同时有罪而冷静地设置了地平板,每个都出于不同的原因. 如表2所显示的27B基数,内疚促进了"内疚"一词本身,而其前五名中的其他四人则是来自其他语言的不相干词片和符号. 冷静的顶级标志是一般的正值, 这些统计是12项的整数,该部分将提出全家庭索赔,而不是任何单一的细胞统计。

blocks.en: Table 3: On-theme verdicts by emotion and cell. \FBsym ✓ marks an on-theme verdict and \FBsym ✗ an off-theme one.
blocks.zh: 表3:按情感和细胞分列的主题判决。 fBsym 标出主题裁决 和 fBsym 标出非主题裁决

blocks.en: 6.2 When emotion words become readable
blocks.zh: 6.2 请检查date=中的日期值 (帮助) 当情感词变得可读

blocks.en: We now ask when, in depth, emotion words become readable. The test here comes from Hollowell (2026) , which defines readability onset as the layer where the median rank of each emotion’s own word, among the 256,000 tokens its vector scores, crosses below 10,000, or roughly the top 4 percent of the vocabulary. A rank near the middle of the 256,000-token vocabulary means the word is promoted no better than chance. As a single-token test, it runs only on the 140 of the 171 emotions whose word is a single token (e.g., “happy”) and not on those whose word has multiple tokens (e.g., “grief-stricken”). No cross-cell direction was registered for this contrast, so the difference in scale below is descriptive.
blocks.zh: 我们现在要问的是,情感词何时可以读取。 这里的测试来自Hollowell(2026年),它定义了可读性发端,即每个情感本身词的中位分,在256,000个符号中的矢量分数中,跨越了10,000分以下,或大约占词汇前4%. 在256,000-token词汇中接近于中位的军衔意味着这个词的提升并不比机会更好. 作为单键测试,它只运行在171个情绪中的140个,其单词为单键(如"快活"),而不会运行在那些词有多键(如"快活")的人身上. 这个对比没有记录出跨细胞取向,所以下面的尺度差异是描述性的.

blocks.en: The final normalization is a real step between the residual stream and the logits, so a test of what the output vocabulary can read should pass through it, unlike the projection of §6.1. Following Hollowell (2026, §7.2 to §7.3) , we normalize in the (1 + w) form Gemma 2 uses (Appendix E). This is a vocabulary projection of an extracted direction, not of a residual state, so its ranks describe this projection and not the logits the model itself would produce at that layer.
blocks.zh: 最终的正常化是剩余流和对数之间的一个真正的步骤,因此测试输出词汇可以读到哪些内容应该通过它,与第6.1节的投影不同. 在Hollowell(2026,§7.2至§7.3)之后,我们在Gemma 2的用法(1+w)中实现常态化(附录E). 这是提取方向的词汇投影,而不是剩余状态,所以它的分级来描述这个投影,而不是模型本身在该层产生的对数.

blocks.en: In both 27B cells, the emotion words begin unreadable and stay unreadable for half the network (Figure 4 ). The median rank starts nearly at chance, 127,700 in base and 128,600 in tuned, falls across the early and middle layers, and still sits near 25,500 in base and 26,000 in tuned at layer 21. At layer 23, exactly half depth, it drops in one step to about 6,300 in base and 3,700 in tuned, and the emotion words become readable. We call this run of layers across which emotion words are unreadable a gate, and it appears only in the 27B cells. The four smaller cells’ median ranks sit between 3,700 and 5,100 at layer 0, already readable, and never rise above 7,750 at any layer. That is a claim about the median emotion, since per-emotion ranks at layer 0 spread widely in those cells and not every emotion reads early. Appendix F splits the same readout by valence and finds positive emotion words readable no later than negative ones in every cell, while negative words end the more readable in all six.
blocks.zh: 在两个27B细胞中,情感单词开始无法读取,为半个网络(图4. 中位分从几乎偶然起步,基座为127,700分,调取为128,600分,从早期到中层相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相 在23层,完全有一半的深度,它一步地下降到了基部的大约6300个和调取的3700个,而情感词变得可以读取. 我们称这一系列 情感词是无法读取的, 它只在27B细胞中出现。 四个较小的细胞的中位数排在0层3,700至5,100之间,已经可以读取,任何一层都不会超过7,750。 这是关于中位情感的说法, 因为每层0的情绪排行 广泛分布在这些细胞中, 而不是每一个情绪都读取早期。 附 录 F用等值分出相同的读取,发现正情感字不晚于每个单元格中的负情感字可读取,而负情感字则结束于所有6个中更可读取.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Median own-word rank by depth, with the consolidation seams marked. Each curve is one cell’s median rank for its own emotion word in the projected vocabulary, over the 140 single-token emotions. Seams (§6.3) are defined at the .97 agreement criterion.
blocks.zh: 图4:中自字按深度排列,并标出合并接缝. 每个曲线是细胞在预测词汇中自身情感词的中位数,超过140个单托式情感. 在.97协议标准中界定了接合(第6.3节)。

blocks.en: Both patterns, the late onset at 27B and the early readability at 2B and 9B, hold under resampling. Across 500 redraws of the cleanup basis, the onset stays at layer 23 in both 27B cells, and the four smaller cells read from layer 0 in every draw. We also passed random directions through the same readout, and they score near chance at all three widths, so the early readability comes from the emotion vectors themselves and not from the lower-dimensional residual streams of the smaller models. Appendix E reports these checks and the effect of removing the normalization and the cleanup in turn. Without the cleanup, 2B tuned no longer reads early.
blocks.zh: 两种模式,即晚发于27B和早发可读于2B和9B,都由再生所维持. 超过500个重画清理基础,发作时间停留在两个27B细胞的第23层,四个较小的细胞从每平面的第0层读取. 我们也通过同样的读出,它们得分接近机会,所有三个宽度,所以早期的可读性来自情感向量本身,而不是较小模型的下维残余流. 附 录 E报告了这些检查以及取消正常化和清理的效果。 没有清理,2B调制后不再提前阅读.

blocks.en: The readability gate we observe here is the sharpest discontinuity by scale across the Gemma 2 family. At 2B and 9B the emotion words read from the first layer, yet at 27B they cannot be read for half the network and then become readable in a single step. We explore the gate further in §6.3, but for now notice that this claim is about when the vocabulary projection can read an emotion word, not when the emotion’s vector is present in the residual stream. Valence sits in the embedding table of both 27B cells, and transport maps refit on embedding-table vectors recover held-out emotions at median rank 1 (§5.1, unregistered), yet the lens reads those cells’ emotion words at chance at layer 0 and outside the top 10,000 until layer 23.
blocks.zh: 我们观测到的可读性门 是整个Gemma 2家族中 最大的不连续性 在2B和9B时,情绪单词是从第一层读取的,然而在27B时,它们不能被读取一半的网络,然后在一步骤中变得可以读取. 我们进一步在§6.3中探索这个门,但现在注意,这个说法是当词汇投影能够读出一个情感单词时,而不是当情绪的向量存在于剩余流中时. Valence坐在两个27B细胞的嵌入表上,在嵌入式表载体上重现的迁移图在中位1(§5.1,未注册)恢复被搁置的情绪,然而镜头在0层和前一万外偶然读取了这些细胞的情感词,直到23层.

blocks.en: Further, logit-lens readouts degrade away from the final layer ( Belrose et al., 2023 ) , but that degradation does not explain the readability difference by scale. All six cells read through one operation, so a degradation that depended only on distance from the final layer would affect every cell alike at the same distance, and 9B, nearly as deep as 27B, reads from layer 0. Only 27B has a readability gate, so something specific to 27B’s intermediate layers could be responsible, in the instrument or in the model. §10 describes the test that would separate the two.
blocks.zh: 此外,对数式读出从最后一层降解(Belrose等人,2023年),但这种降解并不能解释可读性在尺度上的差异。 所有6个细胞都通过一个操作读取,所以仅依赖于与最终层相距的降解会影响每一个细胞在同一距离上,而9B几乎深至27B从层读取. 零点 只有27B有可读性门,因此27B的中间层的特异性可以在仪器或模型中负责. §10描述了将两者分开的测试.

blocks.en: 6.3 The 27B gate at the consolidation seam
blocks.zh: 第6.3条 27B门在合并接合处

blocks.en: If the 27B readout changes at layer 23, does the emotion geometry change there as well? To ask, we reuse the cosine between two 171-by-171 similarity tables (§4.2), but within one cell rather than between cells. For each layer, we score how closely that layer’s table agrees with the analysis layer’s table (L31 for 27B). With this measure, Hollowell (2026) observed a seam in 27B base from layers 22 to 26, where cross-layer similarity to L31 rose from .89 toward .999, with a seam-band mean of .978. For this unregistered measure we locate the consolidation seam at the first layer where that agreement reaches .97 and holds for three layers, so that it can be compared with the readability onset of §6.2. The seam moves with the choice of .97, though across thresholds from .95 to .98 the 27B seam moves by at most one layer, and the smaller cells’ seams stay between a seventh and about a third of depth (Appendix E).
blocks.zh: 如果27B读出在 第23层改变, 情绪几何 也改变在那里吗? 问一下,我们在两个171比-171相似度表(§4.2)之间重复使用余弦,但是在一个细胞内而不是在细胞间. 对于每一层,我们得分该层的表与分析层的表(L31 for 27B)相近。 通过这一措施,霍洛韦尔(2026年)观察到了从第22层到26层的27B基座上的一个接缝,与L31的跨层相似度从.89升至.999,接缝带平均值为9.78. 对于这一未登记的措施,我们将合并接合点放在协议达到.97并维持了三层的第一层,以便与第6.2节的可读性开始相提并论。 接合器随.97的选择而移动,虽然从.95到.98跨越了阈值,但27B接合器在最多一层移动,而较小的细胞接合器则停留在深度的七分之一到一分之一左右(附录E)之间.

blocks.en: In both 27B cells the consolidation seam sits at layer 23, exactly coincident with the readability onset at half of each cell’s 46 layers. The smaller cells’ seams come much earlier, at layer 7 in both 2B cells, 27 percent of depth, and at layer 9 in 9B base and layer 10 in 9B tuned, 21 and 24 percent. Under the 500 redraws of the cleanup basis from §6.2, the 27B seam stays at layer 23 or 24. The distance between seam and onset is zero in 89.6 percent of draws in base and 75.6 percent in tuned, never exceeding one layer.
blocks.zh: 在两个27B细胞中,整合接合层都位于第23层,与每个细胞46层的一半的可读性发作完全吻合。 较小的细胞的接合时间要早得多,在2B细胞的第七层,深度为27%,在9B基座的第九层和9B座的第十层,分别是21%和24%。 在从第6.2节重新绘制的500个清理基础下,27B接合线会停留在23或24层. 接合和发起之间的距离为零,占底部抽取量的89.6%,占75.6%,从未超过一层。

blocks.en: We pre-stated two tests to calibrate our analysis of readability and consolidation coinciding (Appendix E). The first replaces the onset line of §6.2 with a rank taken from each cell’s own median-rank trajectory, about 2,300 in 27B base and 1,700 in 27B tuned, four to six times stricter than 10,000. The rule fixed in advance counts a crossing that rounds to layers 22 to 25 as coincident with the seam. Both cells cross that line between layers 25 and 26, two to three layers past the seam. Rounded to the nearest layer, the tuned cell’s crossing is 25 and counts as coincident, and the base cell’s is 26 and counts as noncoincident, though the two differ by a fifth of a layer.
blocks.zh: 我们预先进行了两次测试,以校正我们对可读性和合并性的分析(附录E)。 第一种是将第6.2节的起发线取而代之的是每个细胞自身中位数轨迹的分级,27B基数约为2,300分,27B基数约为1,700分,比一万分更严格4到6倍. 预先确定的规则把从第22至25层到接缝的交叉点算在内。 两个细胞都越过了第25层和第26层之间的线条,两到三层穿过接缝. 切入到最接近的地层,调制的细胞的跨度为25个并算为相通,而基细胞的跨度为26个并算为非相通,尽管两者相差五分之一。

blocks.en: The second test tightens the readability line from the top 10,000 tokens to the top 1,000 and the top 100, and fixes in advance a window of layers 18 to 28 in which a crossing would count as coincident. Both cells first cross 1,000 at layer 29 and 100 at layer 34, six and eleven layers after the seam, so neither passes the test.
blocks.zh: 第二次测试将可读性线从前一万个信使收紧到前一千个信使和前一百个信使,提前将18至28个地层的窗口进行修整,其中一行会算作相通. 两个细胞在接合后先于第29层与第100层,第34层,第6层与第11层相接而过1000个,因此两者都未能通过试验.

blocks.en: What survives, then, is a remarkable, but conditional, coincidence. In both 27B cells, and in none of the four smaller cells, the layer at which the geometry consolidates is the layer at which emotion words first become readable, and the two stay within a layer of each other across every redraw of the cleanup basis. Under stricter conditions, particularly as the readability measure tightens, the phenomena separate.
blocks.zh: 幸存下来的是惊人但有条件的巧合 在两个27B细胞中,在四个更小的细胞中,没有一个细胞中,几何相融合的地层是情感词首先可以被读取的地层,两个细胞在清理基础的每一个重划上,都停留在相接的地层内. 在更严格的条件下,特别是在可读性措施收紧的情况下,现象是分开的。

blocks.en: 7 Tuning effects
blocks.zh: 7 调制效应

blocks.en: This section asks what instruction tuning changes in the core emotion geometry. At 2 / 3 \nicefrac{{2}}{{3}} depth, tuning leaves every registered measure within its floor (§7.1). However, at every size the valence correlation rises and the arousal correlation falls, by less than their floors and contrary to our prediction for arousal. Base and tuned activation profiles on neutral dialogues largely agree, though their finer differences are not preserved at 9B (§7.2). Tuning’s perturbation of the geometry grows across successive thirds of the network at every size, but the late rise at 27B depends on the final layer (§7.3). Tuning also displaces some emotions much more than others, and that ranking agrees across sizes (§7.4).
blocks.zh: 本节询问核心情感几何学中哪些指令会调整变化. 在 2 / 3\nicefrac + 3 + 3 + 深度时,调制会将每个已注册的量度留在地上(§7.1)。 然而,无论大小,能量的关联性都上升了,激发的关联性下降了,比其地平线还小,与我们对激发的预测相反。 中性对话的基础和调制激活简介基本一致,尽管其更细微的差异没有保留在9B(§7.2). 图宁对几何学的扰动在网络的相接相接的三分之一之间以每个大小增长,但27B的后期上升取决于最后的地层(§7.3). Tuning也取代了一些情感比其他情感要多得多,这种排名在大小上是一致的(§7.4).

blocks.en: 7.1 The tuning battery
blocks.zh: 第7.1条 调音电池

blocks.en: Here we test base-to-tuned differences in emotion geometry, beginning with valence and arousal correlations. We registered predictions that instruction tuning would raise both correlations.

The rise in valence correlation meets our predicted direction but is neither significant under the registered test nor above the floor, and the arousal change has the wrong sign for our prediction, at every size as well as pooled (Table 4 ). Every other analysis-layer measure with a registered floor stays within it, at every size and pooled.

Mid-late layer stability, the agreement of the emotion geometry among the sampled layers at or past half depth, rises under tuning by more than its floor, carried by the 27B pair. blocks.en: The .15 floor on the correlation rows inherits the independence assumption of the Fisher tests (§3), which makes it six to fifteen times stricter than it would be if the standard errors allowed for the emotions both correlations share (Table ). An unregistered bootstrap that allows for that dependence puts all four pooled correlation shifts on one side of zero (Table ). blocks.en: The geometry measured in §7.1 describes where the emotions sit relative to one another. It does not describe what each emotion’s vector reads from the model’s activations on neutral text, and tuning could change that without moving the geometry. Sofroniew et al. blocks.en: A probe here is an emotion’s raw vector from §3, before cleaning. Its reading on a dialogue is the cosine between the vector and the model’s activation on that dialogue, so a high reading means the activation points the way the emotion’s vector does. For each size we take the tuned cell’s 171 probes and apply them to both the base and the tuned model on the same 500 neutral dialogues (§3). An emotion’s reading for a cell is the mean of its per-dialogue readings at the analysis layer, and a cell’s 171 readings form its activation profile. The analysis is unregistered. It is an analog of the comparison in Sofroniew et al. (2026) , not a replication, because their prompts and token position differ from ours (Appendix G).
blocks.zh: 这里的探测器是情感的原始载体, 它在对话上的读取是矢量与模型在对话上的活化之间的同位素,所以高读取就意味着活化指向了情感活化的矢量的方式. 对于每个大小,我们取出调制细胞的171个探测器,并将其应用到基座和调制模型上相同的500个中性对话框上(§3). 一种情绪对细胞的读取是它在分析层的每个对话读取的平均值,一个细胞的171个读取构成它的活化剖面. 分析未经登记。 这是Sofroniew等人(2026年)的比较的类似,而不是复制,因为他们的提示和象征位置不同于我们(附录G).

The ten emotions tuning lowers most are nostalgic, regretful, remorseful, guilty, sympathetic, reflective, sentimental, self-critical, jealous, and sorry, and most of that group is guilt-related (regretful, remorseful, guilty, sorry, self-critical) or wistful (nostalgic, reflective, sentimental). The Gemma shifts are at most weakly related to the per-emotion shifts Sofroniew et al. (2026) report for Claude Sonnet 4.5 (Appendix G).
