blocks.en: 7.3 Tuning’s perturbation grows with depth
blocks.zh: 7.3 图宁的扰动会随着深度增长

blocks.en: Sofroniew et al. (2026, Figure 84) report from probe activations that post-training changes Claude’s emotion representations more at mid-late layers than at early ones. We examine this question across the Gemma 2 family with unregistered exploratory analyses of the geometry and of the activation shifts defined in §7.2. At each layer, a cell has a table of cosine similarities between every pair of distinct emotions among the 171. We correlate a base cell’s table with its tuned cell’s table at the same layer and define perturbation as one minus that Pearson correlation. Perturbation measures disagreement in the pattern of pairwise similarities. Pearson centers each table, so a shift in the overall level of the similarities, which the uncentered cosine of §4.2 would register, does not enter. We divide each model’s layers into three consecutive thirds of near-equal size, with any leftover layers added one each to the earliest thirds, and average within each third (Table 5 ).
blocks.zh: Sofroniew等人(2026年,图84)从探测器活化中报告,训练后改变克洛德的情绪表现在中后期比早期更强. 我们通过未登记的几何和7.2节所定义的活化变化的探索性分析,在Gemma 2家族中审查这一问题。 在每一层,一个细胞都有一个表,显示171之间每一对不同的情感之间的同心素相似性. 我们把基细胞的表与同一层的基细胞的表联系起来,并将扰动定义为一个减去皮尔逊的关联。 扰动测量法在对等相似性模式上存在分歧. 皮尔逊将每个表集中起来,因此,第4.2节未集中的同位素所记录的相似性整体水平的变化不会输入。 我们把每个模型的地层分为近等大小的连续三分之三,任何遗留地层在最早的地层中各增加一分之一,每地层内平均分之一(表5).

blocks.en: Perturbation rises from the early to the middle to the late third at every size. At 27B the late rise comes from the last two layers. Across the 27B pair, perturbation is .0056 at layer 43, then .0882 at layer 44 and .1755 at layer 45, the final layer, where §8.3 documents base 27B as divergent by a separate measure. Without layers 44 and 45 the 27B late third falls below its early third (Table 5 , Appendix G). Geometric perturbation therefore rises across successive thirds at every Gemma 2 size, although the late rise at 27B depends on the final layer. This resembles Claude’s reported depth pattern, measured there through probe activations.
blocks.zh: 扰动从早期到中后期到后三,每个大小都有. 在27B时,后起子来自最后两层. 在27B对上,扰动在43层为.0056分,再在44层为.0882分,在45层为1755分,是最后一层,其中第8.3分文将27B作为分量的分量. 没有第44层和第45层,27B后期第3层低于其早期第3层(表5,附录G)。 因此,几何扰动在每Gemma 2个大小上相继上升了三分之一,尽管后起相差27B取决于最后一层. 这与克劳德报告的深度图案相似,

blocks.en: Table 5: Mean perturbation and mean activation shift, by third of each model’s layers. Layers in each third: 2B 0 to 8, 9 to 17, 18 to 25. 9B 0 to 13, 14 to 27, 28 to 41. 27B 0 to 15, 16 to 30, 31 to 45. The three further 27B rows drop the named layers from the late third.
blocks.zh: 表5:平均扰动和平均活化变化,按每个模型的三分之一层分列。 每三层的地层:2B 0至8,9至17,18至25,9B 0至13,14至27,28至41,27B 0至15,16至30,31至45. 后三行27B又从后三行放下了被命名的地层.

blocks.en: Sofroniew et al. measured depth on activations, so we also put the depth question to the activation shifts of §7.2. At each layer we take the absolute value of each emotion’s shift and average over the 171 emotions. This mean shift does not grow steadily with depth. Averaged by thirds, it rises then falls at 2B and falls then rises at 9B and 27B (Table 5 ). Our activation measure differs from theirs, so this difference between Gemma 2 and Claude cannot be attributed to the models (Appendix G).
blocks.zh: Sofroniew等人测量了活化的深度,因此我们也把深度问题放在了第7.2节活化变化上. 每一层,我们都会对171个情感 采取每个情感转变和平均值的绝对值。 这一转移的深度没有稳步增长。 平均增加三分之一,然后上升为2B,再下降为9B和27B(表5)。 我们的活化度量不同于他们的活化度量,因此Gemma 2和Claude之间的这一差异不能归结于模型(Appendix G).

blocks.en: Figure 84 of Sofroniew et al. (2026) also shows that post-training’s early-layer and late-layer shift profiles correlate weakly, appearing as two blocks in a layer-by-layer correlation heatmap. The analogous structure appears at every Gemma 2 size. We correlated the activation shifts between every pair of layers and searched for the single split that best separates early layers from late ones. Layers on the same side of the split correlate at .53 to .65, and layers on opposite sides near zero ( − - .09 to +.14), so tuning’s early-layer and late-layer shifts are largely separate changes. Two null analyses indicate that the separation exceeds what the split search alone produces, but they do not establish a reliable boundary layer (Appendix G).
blocks.zh: Sofroniew等人(2026年)的图84还显示,培训后的早期和后期转移剖面关系薄弱,在逐层关联热图中作为两个块出现。 类似结构出现在每个Gemma 2 个大小。 我们把每一对地层之间的活化变化联系起来, 并寻找能够将早期地层和后期地层最好分开的单一分块。 分层同一侧的地层相通为:.53至.65;对面地层相通为:0(−-.09至+.14),因此调子的上层和后层相相通的相通变化大体是独立的. 两项无效分析表明,分离量超过了分块搜索单独产生的结果,但它们并没有建立可靠的边界层(Appendix G).

blocks.en: 7.4 The exception: a stable ranking of displaced emotions
blocks.zh: 7.4 (中文(简体) ). 例外:流离失所情绪的稳定排序

blocks.en: The tuning contrasts of §7.1 are small in aggregate, and the activation shifts of §7.2 do not agree across sizes. That leaves open whether tuning moves every emotion a little or a few emotions a lot, and whether the few are the same at every size. We ask with displacement, a registered measure defined per emotion (Appendix C). A tuning pair is a base cell and its tuned cell at one size. For each pair, we align the two cells’ leading two axes, as in §4.2. After the alignment each emotion has one position from each cell, and its displacement is the distance between the two. We rank all 171 emotions by displacement. The ranking, the readings drawn from it, and the regression below are unregistered and exploratory. The registered noise reference for displacement was not measured, and redraws of the cleanup basis test the ranking’s stability instead (Appendix G).
blocks.zh: §7.1的调值对比总和很小,而§7.2的活化转动并不同意跨大小. 这样一来,调子是动动每一个情绪,还是动动几个情绪,以及少数情绪在每一个大小上是否都一样,都留下了空洞. 我们提出流离失所问题,这是按情感界定的登记措施(附录C)。 调子对是基细胞及其调子的同大小. 每一对,我们像第4.2节一样,对准两个单元格的两根主轴。 在调整后,每种情感都从每个细胞中有一个位置,而它的迁移是两者之间的距离. 我们把171个情感都排在了流离失所的位置上 排名,从中提取的读取,以及下面的回归都是未注册和探索性的. 登记在册的关于迁移的噪音参考没有测量,对清理基础的重新绘制检验了排名的稳定性(附录G)。

blocks.en: Vindictive, vengeful, and spiteful hold the top three places at 27B but not at the smaller sizes (Appendix G). The three guilt-related emotions, regretful, remorseful, and guilty, rank high at every size. Regretful ranks in the top five of 171 in all three tuning pairs, guilty in the top six, and remorseful in the top thirteen. The family that holds compassionate, grateful, kind, and loving in every cell never leads. The rankings agree across sizes, with a Spearman correlation of .81 between 2B and 27B over all 171 emotions (.790 over the 137 the covariate regression uses), where the activation shifts of §7.2 at the same two sizes correlate at only .23. The activation side agrees with the ranking on the three guilt-related emotions, which are among the ten emotions tuning lowers most at 27B (§7.2), and not on the three vindictive emotions. Displacement and activation shift are separate computations, so that agreement is not one result counted twice, and the three guilt-related emotions are not merely unstable emotions, since their purity sits above average in four of the six cells (Appendix G).
blocks.zh: 报复性,复仇性,和有恶意地将前三位控制在27B上,但不控制在更小的尺寸上(附录G). 这三种与内疚有关的情感,悔恨相向,悔恨相向,有罪相向,名列各大小. 遗憾地排入了前5名的171位,在所有3个调子中,有罪地排入了前6名,悔恨地排入了前13名. 在每一个牢房里都怀有慈悲、感激、慈爱和爱心的家庭,从不领导。 排名在大小之间一致,Spearman在2B到27B之间与所有171个情绪的关联度为.81(在共变回归使用的137个情绪中为790个),在同一两个大小的活化转动仅与.23有关. 活化方面同意在三种与内疚有关的情感上排位,这三种情感在最低的十种情绪中排位为27B(§7.2),而不是在三种复仇性情感上排位. 被置换和活化转变是独立的计算,因此约定不会被计算出一个结果两次,而三个与负罪感有关的情感不仅仅是不稳定的情感,因为它们的纯度在六个细胞中的四个细胞(Appendix G)中高于平均值.

blocks.en: A plausible explanation is that tuning displaces the self-conscious moral emotions, such as guilt and remorse. We tested it with a regression of displacement on an indicator for eight such emotions fixed in advance ( Haidt, 2003 ; Tangney, Stuewig, and Mashek, 2007 ), seven of which enter the regression (Appendix G), with five covariates, pooled across the three tuning pairs. The indicator shows no detectable effect ( β \beta = +0.25, p = .81), but only seven emotions carry it, so the test cannot rule out a large effect in either direction. Two covariates do predict displacement, arousal ( β \beta = +0.24, p = .005) and layer-0 readability, with more readable emotions moving further ( β \beta = − - 0.25 on log rank, p = .014), yet a model built on them at 2B predicts the 27B ranking poorly (Spearman .292). The ranking is stable across sizes, and the predictors that would explain it are not. That tuning displaces emotions in proportion to arousal and layer-0 readability is a hypothesis this study did not register and a future study could test.
blocks.zh: 一个合理的解释是,调和取代了自觉的道德情感,如内疚和悔恨. 我们用预先固定的8个这样的情绪的指标(Haidt, 2003;Tangney, Stuewig, 和Mashek, 2007)进行流离失所的回归测试,其中7个进入回归(Appendix G),有5个共变体,跨越了3个调子对. 该指标显示没有可检测出的效果(β\β=+0.25,p=.81),但只有7个情绪携带,因此测试不能排除任何方向的较大效果. 两个同位素确实预测了迁移,催生(β\β=+0.24,p=.005)和可读性为0,可读性更强的情绪会进一步移动(β\β=--0.25在log级上,p=.014),然而在2B上构建的模型预测27B排名不佳(Spearman 292). 排名在大小之间是稳定的,解释它的预测器则不是。 调整情绪与刺激和可读性成正比是假设 本研究没有记录 未来研究可以测试

blocks.en: The checks in §4 to §7 each test one finding against one alternative. This section revisits aspects of the pipeline that bear on every finding at once and merit robustness checks of their own. blocks.en: 8.1 Other human rating sets leave every verdict but the negative control unchanged
blocks.zh: 第8.1条 其他的人类评分 保留每个判决 但负控制不变

blocks.en: Every registered correlation with human ratings in this paper follows Sofroniew et al. (2026) in using the 45 rated emotions from Russell and Mehrabian (1977) that overlap with 45 of the 171 emotions with extracted vectors. Hollowell (2026) checked base 27B’s axes against two further human norm sources, NRC-VAD ( Mohammad, 2025 ) and Warriner et al. (2013) . We rerun the registered analyses that use human ratings against those two sets, in every cell, with the geometry held fixed and only the rating table changed. Three are not rerun: the two pooled tuning off-diagonals and the scale contrast in valence correlation. Both sources enter in two forms, the natural overlap over every emotion the lexicon rates (161 for NRC-VAD, 126 for Warriner) and a matched set of the registered 45 emotions (45 for NRC-VAD and 42 for Warriner, which lacks three of the terms). With Russell and Mehrabian, that makes five human rating settings, and the pass is an unregistered sensitivity analysis.
blocks.zh: 本文记载的与人类评级的关联如下: Sofroniew等 (2026)在使用从Russell和Mehrabian(1977年)得到的45个被分级的情感时,与被取出矢量的171个情感中的45个重叠. Hollowell(2026年)对照另外两个人类规范来源,NRC-VAD(Mohammad,2025年)和Warriner等人(2013年)检查了27B基地的轴. 我们重新运行了注册分析, 使用人类的评级 与这两套, 在每一个细胞, 并固定的几何 并且只有评级表改变。 三不是再运行:两个集合调值离对角和等价关系上的规模对比. 两个来源都以两种形式输入,每种情绪的自然重叠率是:词汇率(NRC-VAD为161分,Warriner为126分)和一套对应的45分情感(NRC-VAD为45分,Warriner为42分,缺少3个术语). 与Russell和Mehrabian一起,这创造了5个人类评级设置,而"传"是未注册的敏感性分析.

blocks.en: No registered verdict changes under any of the four additional settings, apart from a single negative control, which we take up in §8.2. The tuning nulls stay null, and the two arousal measures of §5.3 keep their direction in every chain under every setting. The pooled valence delta reaches nominal significance under the largest overlap only (n = 161, p = .036), and its registered verdict stays null. Norm choice moves most effect sizes modestly, and the only verdict it moves is the negative control’s (§8.2). The largest moves are in the arousal-tracking rise of §5.3, which falls below the .15 floor in both chains on the two natural overlaps (base +.059 and +.077, tuned +.131 and +.129) and in the base chain on NRC-VAD matched (+.145). Its verdict, null after Holm, is unchanged.
blocks.zh: 除了我们在第8.2节中采用的单一负控外,在另外四个设置中的任何一种情况下,没有登记的判决变化。 调音无效仍为无效,第5.3节的两个振动措施在每一个场合下保持其在每个链中的方向. 集合价值三角洲在最大重叠(n = 161,p = .036)下具有名义意义,其注册判决无效。 标准选择移动效果最大,其移动的唯一判断是负控(§8.2). 最大的动作是催生跟踪上升5.3节,在两个自然相重叠的链条(基数+.059和+.077,调取+.131和+.129)和NRC-VAD匹配的基数链(+.145)上均低于15分. 其判决在霍尔姆之后无效,没有改变.

blocks.en: Table 6: Every registered verdict that uses human ratings, under five norm settings. The registered setting is the 45-emotion Russell and Mehrabian overlap. Per-setting numbers are in Appendix E.
blocks.zh: 表6:在5个规范设置下,每个使用人类评级的注册判决. 所注册的设定是45-情感拉塞尔和梅赫拉比的重叠. 每个设定的编号载于附录E。

blocks.en: Of note in Table 6 is the embedding-table asymmetry, which we observed in §5.1. The moderate correlation with valence and the weak correlation with arousal hold across five human rating settings, so the choice of Russell and Mehrabian (1977) is not what produces it. The depth gap (§5.3) is measured from the weak embedding-table arousal correlation, and our interpretation of the readability gate in 27B cells (§6.2) relies on valence being present at the embedding table. The stability of the asymmetry across ratings sets strengthens those findings.
blocks.zh: 表6中值得注意的是嵌入表不对称,我们在第5.1节中观察到了这一点。 与活泼的温和的关联性,与激起的关联性薄弱,占据了人类的五个评级环境,因此罗素和梅赫拉比安(1977年)的选择并不是产生它的原因. 深度差距(第5.3节)是从薄弱的嵌入式-表激发式相关性来衡量的,我们对27B细胞中可读性门(第6.2节)的解释依赖于嵌入式表存在等值. 各种评级不对称的稳定性加强了这些调查结果。

blocks.en: 8.2 The arousal axis depends on the emotion set
blocks.zh: 8.2 国家 振动轴取决于情绪

blocks.en: §8.1 names a single negative control that moves with the rating setting, and it concerns the arousal axis. We outline the control first, then how it moves under the five human rating settings.
blocks.zh: §8.1 命名一个随评分设置而移动的单一负控,它涉及振动轴. 我们首先概述控制,然后如何在五个人类评级环境下移动。

blocks.en: The main analysis (§4.1) fits principal components on all 171 emotions and scores the 45 of them that overlap with Russell and Mehrabian (1977) . The control fits the components on those 45 emotions alone and asks whether arousal still lands on the second component. We registered the control for arousal because a change of emotion set is more likely to move the weaker of the two axes, and we registered two predictions: that arousal would leave the second component when the components are fit on 45 emotions, and that tuned cells would keep arousal on the second component more often than base cells.
blocks.zh: 主分析(§4.1)符合所有171个情感的主要成分,并得分其中与Russell和Mehrabian(1977年)重叠的45个. 控制与这45种情绪的成分一致,并询问刺激是否仍然落在第二个成分上. 我们登记了对刺激的控制, 因为情绪的改变 更有可能移动两个轴的弱者, 我们登记了两个预测: 当这些元件适合45个情绪时,刺激会留下第二个元件, 而调谐的细胞会比基细胞更经常地保持对第二个元件的刺激。

blocks.en: In the control, arousal drops from the second component to the third in all six cells, with best correlation magnitudes of .67 to .77, so each cell still carries an arousal axis, but 0 of 6 carry it as the second component. No tuned cell keeps arousal on the second component (0 of 3), so tuning does not differ from base on this measure.
blocks.zh: 在控制中,所有6个细胞都从第二个构件降至第三个构件,最佳相关星等为.67至.77等,因此每个细胞仍会携带一个振荡轴,但0为6作为第二个构件. 调制的单元格在第二个组件(3分之0)上保持振动,因此调制与这个度量的基数没有区别.

blocks.en: The second and third components carry nearly equal variance across cells when fit on the 45 emotions, which makes the rank fragile. 0 of 6 here is a point estimate, the single value from one fit, and resampling shows how it changes over repeated fits. In an unregistered check that re-grades nothing, we resampled the 45 rated emotions 1,000 times, with each draw shared across the six cells. Arousal lands on the second component in .25 to .36 of draws per cell. The 0 of 6 is the most common outcome across draws but recurs in only .59 of them, and all six cells land on the second component together in .22 (Appendix E, Table ). With the primary set of 45 emotions, then, the second and third components are close to a tie, and which one arousal falls on changes from fit to fit in each cell. The instability is consistent with Sun et al. (2026) , who found no single component for arousal on 27 emotions. Hollowell (2026) refit base 27B on random subsets of 27 emotions and reproduced their null in most of them.
blocks.zh: 第二和第三部分在45个情感上 有着几乎相等的细胞间差异 这使得排名变得脆弱 6的0是一个点估计, 单值从一个适中, 并重印显示它如何变化 超过重复适中。 在一次没有注册的重新等级的检查中,我们重印了45个被评分的情感1000次,每张图都分享到6个细胞. 每个细胞的25至36个抽取量中,催生在第二个部分。 6分之0是整个图中最常见的结果,但在其中只有.59分复出,所有6分之一的细胞在.22分之一(附录E,表.)。 有了45个主情感,那么,第二和第三个元件就接近平分,而其中一个振动就从适合到适合每个细胞的变化. 不稳定性与Sun等人(2026年)一致,后者在27个情绪上没有发现任何单一的激发成分. Hollowell (2026) 在27个情感的随机子集上重现了27B的基础,并在大部分的情感中再现了它们的无效.

blocks.en: The additional human ratings sources of §8.1 let us ask two further questions of this control. First, whether its outcome depends on Russell and Mehrabian’s particular ratings. On NRC-VAD’s matched set of the same 45 emotions, arousal lands on the second component in 0 of 6 cells, and on Warriner’s matched 42 emotions in 2 of 6. Second, we can ask whether the size of the rated set matters. Fitting on 161 emotions for NRC-VAD and 126 for Warriner restores arousal to the second component under NRC-VAD (5 of 6) and not under Warriner (2 of 6), on point estimates and under resampling alike (Table ). In short, this establishes no direction across sources. The two larger sets also differ in composition and coverage at once, and the series cannot separate the two. Under resampling in every setting, the registered one included, arousal’s principal component rank changes from draw to draw in every cell.
blocks.zh: 第8.1节的额外人类评级来源让我们再问两个关于这种控制的问题。 首先,其结果是否取决于罗素和梅赫拉比安的特定收视率. 在NRC-VAD的相配的同为45个情感组合上,激起在6个细胞中以0为0的第二部分,而华瑞纳的相配为2个6个中的42个. 第二,我们可以问评分集的大小是否重要. NRC-VAD的161个情绪和Warriner的126个情绪使NRC-VAD(6个中的5个)而不是Warriner(6个中的2个)的第二个部分恢复了振奋力,在点数估计和重作相同(表)。 简言之,这不能确定各种来源之间的方向。 两套较大的套装同时在组成和覆盖范围上也有所不同,系列不能将两者分开. 在每一个场合的再取样中,登记在册的单元包括:鼓动器的主要部件从抽取到抽取的分级变化。

blocks.en: 8.3 One divergent layer behind two registered verdicts
blocks.zh: 第8.3条 在两个已登记的判决后面有一个不同的层次

blocks.en: Sofroniew et al. (2026) measured how steady Claude’s emotion geometry stays across fourteen evenly spaced layers, and we registered a measure of that stability for every cell. We sample fourteen layers, which in the 46-layer 27B cells are layers 0, 3, 7, 10, 14, 17, 21, 24, 28, 31, 35, 38, 42, and 45. At each sampled layer we take the 14,535 cosines among the 171 cleaned emotion vectors (§3), and we correlate those cosine tables between layers. Mid-late layer stability is the average of those correlations among the seven sampled layers at or past half depth, 24 through 45 at 27B, so it is high when the geometry changes little from one late layer to the next. Three registered contrasts test mid-late stability against a floor of .01: tuning, pooled over the three sizes, and scale from 2B to 27B in each chain (Table ). A fourth registered contrast tests tuning on stability averaged over all fourteen layers.
blocks.zh: Sofroniew等人(2026年)测量了克洛德的情感几何在14个平平相间的地层上是否保持稳定,我们记录了每个细胞的稳定性。 我们抽取了14个地层,在46层的27B细胞中是地层0,3,7,10,14,17,21,24,28,31,35,38,42和45. 在每一个取样层,我们取出171个清洁的情感载体中的14 535个同位素(§3),我们将这些同位素表连接在了各层之间。 中后期地层稳定性是7个采样地层在半深或过半深处,24至45分在27B处的等同关系平均值,因此当几何从一后期地层到一后期的几何变化不大时,这种关联性很高. 3个注册对比点对0.01的下限进行了中后期稳定性测试:调和,集合在3个大小之间,并在每个链条中从2B到27B的比例(表)。 在所有14个层中平均对稳定性进行了第四次对比测试。

blocks.en: Two of the three mid-late contrasts cleared the floor. Tuning raises stability by +.0142 pooled, and scale lowers it in the base chain by − - .0424, both real by the case bootstrap fixed at grading (§3). The scale contrast in the tuned chain is sub-floor ( − - .0003), and the all-layer tuning contrast is sub-floor at +.0007.
blocks.zh: 三个中后期对比中有两个清除了地板. Tuning通过+.0142集合提高稳定性,规模将基链中的稳定性降低−-.0424,两者都通过定级时的皮靴套来真实(§3). 调制链中的平面对比为下层(--.0003),全层调制对比为下层(+.0007).

blocks.en: A verdict can be real and still rest on a single layer, so we drop layer 45 and regrade. Base 27B’s mid-late stability is .949, against .992 to .993 in the other five cells, because its cosine table at layer 45 agrees poorly with its tables at the other six late layers. Dropping layer 45 from both 27B cells lifts base 27B to .994, just above the range of the other five cells, sends the tuning contrast to zero at this precision, and reverses the sign of both scale contrasts (Appendix H). The two contrasts that cleared the floor therefore rest on one fact: base 27B’s geometry departs from its own late geometry at layer 45, and tuned 27B’s barely does, which is why the tuning contrast is carried by the 27B pair (Table 4 ).
blocks.zh: 判决可以是真实的,并且仍然停留在单一的一层上,所以我们放下了第45层,重新分级. Base 27B的中后期稳定性为949,而其他5个细胞为992到993,因为其第45层的同位素表与其它6个后期的表不太一致. 从两个27B细胞的下移层45将基数27B提升到994,略高于其他五个细胞的范围,在这种精度下将调相反向为零,并倒转两个相比的标志(附录H). 因此,清理地层的两种对比基于一个事实:基数27B的几何学在地层45偏离了自己的后几何学,而调制了27B的几何学,这几乎就是调制对比由27B对所承载的原因(表4)。

blocks.en: The divergence belongs to the model and not to one extraction run. We re-extracted base 27B at three of the sampled layers, 45, 42 before it, and the analysis layer 31 as a control, twice with different seeds under a rule fixed before the second seed was read, and the divergence appeared on both seeds. A sweep of every layer from 42 to 45, including the unsampled 43 and 44, shows that it builds gradually, steepest between layers 43 and 44, and spreads across many dimensions, and that the tuned cell’s divergence is much milder (Appendix H).
blocks.zh: 差异属于模型,而不是一个取出运行。 我们重取了被采样的地层中三个地基27B,先于45,42个地层,分析地层31作为一个控制,在第二个地层被读取之前,在定出规则下有两次不同的种子,两种地层上都出现了分歧. 对42到45层的扫描,包括未取样的43和44层,显示它逐渐地建立起来,在43和44层之间最陡峭,并分布在许多维度上,被调谐的细胞的分量要轻得多(附录H).

blocks.en: This finding is why we reported the 27B late third with and without its final two layers (§7.3), since final layers are known to specialize for the output task ( Voita et al., 2019 ; Lad et al., 2024 ) . It is also why we recommend pairing any depth-band contrast with a check that drops one layer at a time. Why base 27B diverges at its final layers is an open question, and whether other families’ base models do the same is one a second family grid would answer (§10).
blocks.zh: 这一发现正是我们报告27B后期第三层有和没有最后两层的原因(§7.3),因为已知最后层专门从事产出任务(Voita等,2019;Lad等,2024)。 这也是为什么我们建议将任何深度带对比值与一次下降一层的检查相配. 为什么27B基础在最后的层次上存在分歧是一个有待解决的问题,而其他家庭的基础模式是否也一样,这是第二个家庭网格的答案之一(§10)。

blocks.en: 8.4 Audit and the cosine noise floor
blocks.zh: 8.4 审计和余弦噪音层

blocks.en: Every claim carrying a graded verdict in this study passed an adversarial audit, and the prompts and reports ship as supplementary artifacts. Each audit extended the protocol of Hollowell (2026) , where a fresh-context Claude session received the claim and the artifacts but nothing of the session that produced them. We instructed the session to refute the claim by independent recomputation from the artifacts.
blocks.zh: 本研究中每一份带有分级判决的索赔都通过对抗性审计,提示和报告船为补充文物. 每次审计都延长了Hollowell的协议(2026年),其中克劳德会议收到了索赔和文物,但没有收到产生这些物品的会议。 我们指示会议通过对文物进行独立重判来驳斥这一说法。

blocks.en: Most audits received the claimed values as targets. A smaller set received none, derived every number from the raw inputs, and wrote the audit results down before opening the artifact to compare. A separate fresh-context grader, with no connection to either the producing or the auditing session, proposed each grade, and the final rulings were ours.
blocks.zh: 大多数审计都以所称价值为目标。 一个较小的集没有收到,从原始投入中得出每个数字,并在打开文物进行比较之前将审计结果写下来。 一个单独的新鲜文本分级员,与制作或审计会议都无关,提出每个分级,最后的裁决是我们的。

blocks.en: The seven audits reproduced every number the paper takes from the audited files, using independent code. We release the audit protocol in the hope that it is reusable.
blocks.zh: 7项审计采用独立代码转载了文件从被审计文件中取出的每一个编号。 我们发布审计协议,希望它可以重新使用。

blocks.en: We read cosine tables to the third decimal and report here which decimals this pipeline can reproduce. The first source of noise is precision. Vectors extracted in bf16 and in fp32 agree at a mean per-story cosine of .999994 or better at all three sizes, so precision adds almost none.
blocks.zh: 我们把余弦表读到小数点后再报告 哪个小数点可以复制 噪音的第一个来源是精度. 在bf16和fp32中提取的矢量在平均每层同位素为999994或更好,在所有三种尺寸上都一致,因此精度几乎没有增加.

blocks.en: The second source is hardware. Kernel and hardware paths shift numerics through reduction orderings that depend on the batch, and the control that literature recommends is a twin run ( Golden et al., 2024 ; He, 2025 ) . Stored extractions at 9B base and 27B base, compared against fresh ones on a later accelerator, move by a few parts in a thousand. On one accelerator, then, the fifth decimal of a per-story vector’s cosine is noise, and between two accelerators the fourth is. These bounds are measured on single vectors and are not propagated through the averaged and centered quantities the paper compares. Appendix J reports where the error falls at each size and the twin run that anchors the hardware comparison.
blocks.zh: 第二个来源是硬件. 克内尔和硬件路径通过取决于批量的还原命令来转移数字,而文献推荐的控制是双跑(Golden等人,2024;He,2025). 9B基地和27B基地储存取出物,相较于后期加速器上新鲜取出物,千分之数移动. 在一个加速器上,每层向量的同位素的第五小数是噪音,在两个加速器之间,第四个是噪音。 这些界限是用单向量测量的,不通过纸张所比较的平均和中心数量进行传播。 附 录 J报告每个大小出错的地方和锁定硬件比较的双子跑.

blocks.en: 9 Discussion and limitations
blocks.zh: 9 讨论和限制

blocks.en: This section discusses the results of the Gemma 2 family grid (§9.1) and outlines the study’s limitations (§9.2).
blocks.zh: 本节讨论Gemma 2家族网格(§9.1)的结果并概述研究的局限性(§9.2).

blocks.en: 9.1 Discussion
blocks.zh: 9.1 讨论情况

blocks.en: Sofroniew et al. (2026) found a core emotion geometry in Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Hollowell (2026) replicated it in Gemma 2 27B base. We asked whether that emotion geometry holds across the Gemma 2 family, and answer that it does. Every cell exhibits a strong valence axis, a weaker arousal axis, and soft but stable emotion families (§4.1). The geometry corresponds across cells closely enough that an emotion’s vector in one cell predicts its vector in another (§4.3).
blocks.zh: Sofroniew等 (2026)在克洛德·索内 4.5中发现了一个核心情感几何,而霍洛韦尔 (2026)在Gemma 2 27B Base中复制了它. 我们问那感官几何 是否贯穿了Gemma 2家族 并回答它的存在。 每个细胞都显示有强力的活性轴,更弱的活性轴,以及柔软而稳定的情感家族(§4.1)。 几何对应于细胞之间足够紧密地对应一个细胞的情感向量预测出另一个细胞的向量(§4.3).

blocks.en: We also asked how emotion geometry changes with scale, depth, and instruction tuning within the Gemma 2 family. We answer that scale spreads the geometry’s variance across more components (§5.2), that at 27B the emotion words stay unreadable through the output vocabulary for half the network (§6.2), and that tuning leaves the geometry at the analysis layer within every registered floor (§7.1).
blocks.zh: 我们还问,在Gemma 2家族内部,情感几何学如何随着尺度、深度和指示的调整而变化。 我们回答说,比例表将几何的相差分散到更多的组件(§5.2),在27B时,情绪词通过一半的网络的输出词汇(§6.2)一直无法被读取,而调子则将分析层的几何放在每一个注册地层(§7.1).

blocks.en: Scale, more specifically, largely preserves the emotion geometry’s shape while altering its distribution. From 2B to 27B every cell keeps the same axes and closely matching families, and the planes of the nine compared pairs align almost without rotation (§4.2). Larger models put less of the emotion variance on the leading component and spread it across more directions (§5.2). The arousal correlation also rises with size, a lead the registered tests did not confirm (§5.3). The most significant discontinuities by scale in the paper sit at 27B. The readability gate appears only there (§6.2), base 27B’s final layer departs from its own late geometry where no smaller cell’s does (§8.3), and tuning’s activation shifts diverge there (§7.2). Within this family, 2B to 9B is a change of degree and 9B to 27B is where new behavior appears.
blocks.zh: 更具体地说,缩放在很大程度上保留了情感几何形状,同时改变其分布. 从2B到27B,每个单元格都保持同轴并紧密相匹配的家族,而相比较的9对的平面几乎不旋转地对齐(§4.2). 较大的模型将情感差异较小地放在了主元件上并分散到更多的方向上(§5.2). 随着体积的增大,引起轰动的关联性也随之增加,登记测试的铅没有证实(第5.3节)。 按规模划分,论文中最显著的不连续是27B。 可读性门只在那里出现(第6.2节),基数27B的末层脱离了自身较后几何,没有更小的细胞出现(第8.3节),而调谐的活性变换也在那里出现差异(第7.2节)。 在这个家庭中,2B到9B是学位的改变,9B到27B是出现新行为的地方.

blocks.en: Depth matters more as the model grows. In the 2B and 9B cells the emotion words read from the first layer (§6.2), and the geometry at the final layer agrees with the geometry at the layers before it (§8.3), so the emotion geometry of a smaller model is close to the same object at every depth. The 27B cells, in contrast, have phases. For the first half of the network the emotion words cannot be read from the output vocabulary, even though valence is present from the embedding table onward (§5.1), and at half depth they become readable in a single step (§6.2, §6.3). At 27B the geometry holds across the middle layers, yet in the final layers the base model’s geometry moves (§8.3) and tuning’s perturbation rises (§7.3). Depth reveals that the presence of emotion geometry and the readability of emotion words are, in the Gemma 2 family, different phenomena.
blocks.zh: 随着模型的发展,深度更重要。 在2B和9B细胞中,从第一层(§6.2)读取的情感单词,而最后一层的几何与上层(§8.3)的几何一致,因此一个更小的模型的情感几何在每一个深度都接近同一个物体. 相形之下,27B细胞具有相位. 对于上半个网络,情绪词不能从输出词汇中读取,尽管从嵌入表(§5.1)中存在活性,在半深处,它们可以单步读取(§6.2,§6.3). 在27 B时,几何学占据了中层,然而在最后的地层中,基模型的几何运动(§8.3)和调谐的扰动上升(§7.3). 深度揭示出情感几何的存在和情感词的可读性在Gemma 2家族中是不同的现象.

blocks.en: Instruction tuning leaves the base model’s geometry largely in place. Every base cell exhibits the core emotion geometry, and no registered measure at the analysis layer changes beyond its floor under tuning (§4.1, §7.1). This ran against our registered prediction, but accounts of persona selection predict the pattern. For example, the Persona Selection Model ( Marks, Lindsey, and Olah, 2026 ) reads post-training as eliciting an assistant persona from a repertoire the base model already represents, and a geometry the base model already carries is a repertoire of that kind.
blocks.zh: 指令调制使基模型的几何基本到位. 每个基细胞显示核心情感几何,分析层的注册度量在调子下不会改变到地上(§4.1,§7.1)。 这违背了我们的预测, 但描述人物的选择预测模式。 例如,Persona选择模型(Marks, Lindsey, and Olah, 2026)将培训后读作从基础模型已经代表的回想中引出一个助理人物,而基础模型已经携带的几何是这种回想.

blocks.en: Tuning is not entirely inert, though. Its perturbation of the geometry grows with depth at every size and at 27B comes from the last two layers (§7.3). Tuning changes what the emotion vectors read from neutral text differently at 27B than at the smaller sizes (§7.2), and the emotions it displaces most form a stable ranking across sizes (§7.4). Where tuning has an effect, this study’s measurements place it late in the network and in a few emotions rather than in the geometry as a whole.
blocks.zh: 不过,图宁并不完全是惰性的。 它对几何的扰动随深度的大小而增长,在27B时来自后两层(§7.3. 特宁改变情感向量从中文本中读取的内容,在27B时与小尺寸时不同(§7.2),而它取代的情绪大多形成跨大小的稳定排名(§7.4. 如果调子有作用,本研究的测量结果将其放在网络和一些情感中较晚,而不是整个几何中.

blocks.en: Across all three axes, the geometry the family varies is one it largely starts with. We read the family’s emotion geometry as substantially inherited from lexicon and corpus. Once cleaned of generic token statistics, valence reads off the static token-embedding table in every cell, with no forward pass (§5.1). The correspondence between models is already present in those tables, since transport maps refit on embedding-table vectors keep median rank 1 in every pair, as maps fit at the analysis layer do (§4.3, §5.1). And the six models, across three sizes and both tunings, build nearly the same pairwise similarities, valence-arousal plane, and emotion families on top of that embedding table, within a small margin of the instrument’s agreement with itself (§4.2).
blocks.zh: 在所有三根轴上, 几何学上的不同是 它基本上从一个开始。 我们读到家庭的情感几何学, 一旦清理出通用代号统计数据,Valence会从每个单元格中静态代号嵌入表上读出,没有前行通行证(§5.1)。 模型之间的对应关系已经出现在这些表格中,因为运算图在嵌入式表矢量上重现,每对中位数都保持中位数1,就像分析层的地图一样(§4.3,§5.1)。 而六个模型,跨越了三个大小和两个调子,在器件本身协议的很小范围内(第4.2节),在嵌入表上搭建了几乎相同的对等相像,活泼平面和情感家族.

blocks.en: Why does the table carry so much of the emotion geometry and yet so little of arousal? Valence is the geometry’s largest component, holding about twice the emotion variance that arousal does in every cell, and two and a half times at 2B (§4.1), and valence is the axis the table already supplies (§5.1). Each model’s layers add to both axes, but arousal starts from almost nothing at the table and owes nearly all its strength to the forward pass (§5.1). The arousal axis is also the one that behaves least like a fixed property of the space, since scale may strengthen it (§5.3) and the emotion sample moves it (§8.2). One potential explanation, that valence is lexical and arousal is situational, cannot be adjudicated by these tests alone.
blocks.zh: 为什么桌子上有这么多的 情感几何, 却很少的激动? 瓦伦斯是几何体最大的组成部分,持有约两倍于每个细胞所激发的情感差异,2B(§4.1)为2倍半,而瓦伦斯是已经提供(§5.1)的表轴. 每个模型的地层都增加了两根轴,但从桌子上几乎什么都没有开始引起轰动,几乎全靠前行(第5.1节)。 振动轴也是行为最不象空间固定属性的轴,因为尺度可能增强空间(§5.3),而情感样本会移动空间(§8.2). 一种可能的解释,即 " 价值 " 是 " 词汇 " , " 激励 " 是 " 情况 " ,不能仅靠这些检验来裁定。

blocks.en: How far these results reach past the Gemma 2 family remains open. §10 sets out this and other open questions that this study could not settle.
blocks.zh: 这些结果在Gemma 2家族仍然保持开放。 §10规定了本研究无法解决的这个问题和其他未决问题。

blocks.en: 9.2 Limitations
blocks.zh: 9.2 限制

blocks.en:
• Following Sofroniew et al. (2026) and Hollowell (2026) , we assume throughout that emotion concepts are represented as linear directions in activation space. A single vector may capture blended or complex emotions poorly, and a linear vector is generic with respect to binding and directionality toward characters. Like Sofroniew et al. (2026) , we cannot be certain the vectors “capture all or only the emotion concepts we intend,” nor that they are free of confounds. • This study is observational and measures representations of emotion concepts, with no steering and no behavioral measure. No result here shows that or how Gemma 2 models use these representations when they generate text, and neither the presence of emotion geometry nor the readability of emotion words licenses that inference ( Elazar et al., 2021 ; Ravichander, Belinkov, and
Hovy, 2021 ). • The pipeline of Hollowell (2026) , which replicated Sofroniew et al. (2026) , is inherited unchanged and its limitations carry over. The corpus of emotion stories is generated by claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 and is English only, and its validation rests on one human coder, the author, hand-coding 300 sampled stories with no inter-rater statistic. Every Gemma 2 family cell reads the same 205,200 stories, so the transport result of §4.3 concerns the emotion centroids of one shared corpus, and whether transport holds for independently written text remains untested here. • Six cells of Gemma 2 share a pretraining lineage, a tokenizer, and data, so this study does not separate facts about this family from facts about transformers. The three sizes also differ in training regime and not only in parameter count. The Gemma 2 report trains the 2B and 9B checkpoints by distillation from a larger model and the 27B checkpoint from scratch ( Gemma Team , 2024 ), so the size comparisons do not isolate parameter count, and the 27B departures of §9.1 could reflect training from scratch as well as size. The tuning test likewise covers instruction tuning in one family only. • Statistical power on every registered contrast against human ratings is bounded by the 45 emotions that Russell and Mehrabian rated, not by the story sample (§5.3, the §8 contrasts are unregistered). The .15 floor inherits the Fisher tests’ assumption that the two correlations in a contrast come from separate samples, and because both are scored against the same 45 emotions the floor is higher than the data required (§5.3, §7.1). The .10 floor on the norm correlations rests on the same assumption, and how far it overstates the requirement is not measured. A result above a floor would clear a correctly sized one, so above-floor verdicts stand, while a sub-floor null is weaker evidence of absence than the floor suggests. • The adversarial audits (§8.4) and the analyses they audited ran on the same model family. Their independence is contextual rather than a matter of model. • Readability results in §6.2, §6.3, and Appendix F depend on the logit lens and hold within the grid’s own contrast between cells and not against the lens. Lenses degrade away from the final-layer basis ( Belrose et al., 2023 ) , so “readable” in this paper means readable when the emotion vector is projected through the final normalization and unembedding, and a different readout could place the readability gate at a different layer or find it absent altogether.

blocks.en: What produces the 27B gate. In both 27B cells the median emotion word stays outside the top 10,000 until layer 23, while in the four smaller cells it reads from layer 0 (§6.2). The emotion word may already be encoded in the early 27B layers, but along directions the unembedding does not read, so the projection cannot see it. The early layers may not yet encode the word, and the middle layers may build it. The readout itself may contribute, since it projects a difference-of-means vector through an instrument built for residual states (§6.1), though that mismatch holds in every cell and the gate would then be tied to something specific to 27B’s residual stream, such as its massive-activation dimension (Appendix J). The next test is an alternative readout, a tuned lens ( Belrose et al., 2023 ) fit in every cell on text disjoint from the stories and applied to the story activations before the emotion contrasts are taken, with the own-word trajectory and the seam comparison of §6.3 rerun under it and reported beside the present readout. If the alternative readout recovers the emotion words well before layer 23, the gate depends on the projection. If it moves the onset relatively little, the gate survives a change of instrument, which does not yet place it in the model’s computation but makes the seam the place to test next.

blocks.en: The cross-family grid. Whether the results from the Gemma 2 family hold across other model families remains untested. The nearest cross-family scale series is Tagliabue, Dung, and Berg (2026) , whose 25 models include Qwen 2.5 at 7B, 32B, and 72B, base and tuned, though they measure one direction’s separation rather than the geometry of a full emotion set. A subsequent study could apply the same grid in a second family with base and tuned checkpoints, with transport maps fit between the two families as well as within the second, so that correspondence across families is tested and not only replicated within one. The second grid would also show whether a different base model’s final layers diverge as base 27B’s do (§8.3). Ideally, the second family’s training regime should be held fixed across sizes, since Gemma 2 trains its 27B checkpoint from scratch and the smaller two by distillation (§9.2). At least one pair of cells in each family should read both the original stories and a corpus of emotion stories written by a different generator, so that failures can be assigned to the family or to the corpus rather than both at once. Readability should be compared on emotion words that are single tokens in both tokenizers.
blocks.zh: 跨家族网. Gemma 2家族的结果是否贯穿其他模范家庭,仍未检验。 最近的跨家庭尺度系列是塔格利阿布埃,敦和伯格(2026年),他们的25个模型包括了Qwen 2.5 at 7B,32B,以及72B,虽然它们测量一个方向的分离而不是一个全情感集的几何. 随后的一项研究可在设有基地和调节检查站的第二个家庭使用同样的网格,在两个家庭之间以及在第二个家庭内部都配有交通图,以便测试家庭之间的通信,而不仅仅是在一个家庭内复制。 第二个网格还显示,一个不同的基模型的最后地层是否与基数27B的不同(§8.3)。 理想的情况是,第二家的训练制度应固定在跨大小之间,因为Gemma 2从零开始训练其27B检查站,而较小的两个检查站则通过蒸馏(§9.2)。 每个家庭至少有一对细胞应该同时读取由不同生成者所写的原始故事和一连串情感故事,这样失败可以被分配到家庭或本体,而不是同时分配到两个. 可读性应该被比作情绪词,这些词在两种标语中都是单一的符号.

blocks.en: What the embedding table carries forward. PC1 of the vectors drawn from the embedding table correlates with human valence ratings at .48 to .51 in every cell, and PC1 of the vectors at 2 / 3 \nicefrac{{2}}{{3}} depth correlates with them at .71 to .78 (§5.1). It remains open how much the layers strengthen the valence structure already present in the embedding table and how much they develop a different structure that also tracks human valence ratings. Hollis and Westbury (2016) found a component that tracks human valence in the static word vectors of a skip-gram model trained on text alone, so valence structure in a token-embedding table is expected, and the layers’ contribution is the informative part. Within each cell, the valence direction at the table and the valence direction at the 2 / 3 \nicefrac{{2}}{{3}} -depth analysis layer use the same residual-stream coordinates. Two measurements would quantify their alignment: the cosine between the two directions and the share of emotion variance at the analysis layer that lies along the table’s valence direction. Testing whether the later structure depends on the earlier one, rather than merely aligning with it, would require altering activations along the table’s valence direction and measuring the effect at later layers, with controls to distinguish a specific effect on valence from general disruption. Both alignment measurements are computable from the released vectors at the table and at the analysis layer.
blocks.zh: 嵌入式表格所携带的东西。 从嵌入式表格中抽取的向量的PC1与每个单元格中以.48至.51的人类价值评级有关,而以.71至.78(§5.1)的深度以2 / 3\nicefrac{{2}}{{3}}相接的向量的PC1与它们有关(§5.1)。 层层如何加强嵌入式表格中已经存在的等值结构,以及它们在多大程度上发展出一个同样跟踪人类等值评级的不同结构,这一点仍然开放. Hollis和Westbury(2016年)发现了一个组件,用来跟踪一个只受过文字训练的跳格克模型的静态单词矢量中人类的活性能,因此期望一个符号嵌入表中的活性能结构,而地层的贡献是信息部分. 每个单元格内,桌子上的等价取向和2 / 3\nicefrac *============ - 深入分析层使用相同的残余流坐标。 两种测量方法可以量化它们的相通性:两个方向之间的同心圆和沿着表格的活性方向在分析层的情感差异份额。 测试后期结构是否取决于前期结构,而不仅仅是与后期结构保持一致,将要求沿表的活度方向改变活度,并测量后期各层的效果,同时控制以区分对活度的特定影响和一般干扰. 两种相配度量均可以从表和分析层释放的向量中计算出.

blocks.en: The mechanism of variance spreading. We found that Gemma 2’s larger models put less of their emotion variance on the leading component, while the participation ratio rises with scale and the TwoNN point estimates stay similar (§5.2). The next test is held-out prediction of emotion identity and of human ratings from the leading components alone, from the remaining components alone, and from matched component budgets across cells, which asks whether variance outside the leading directions contributes signal. If it does, sparse-feature decomposition on the toolchain Presa and Teles de Oliveira (2026) validated for Gemma 2 9B tuned is the instrument for saying what that signal represents. Their finding that joy and adoration appear only under steering of several features together is one candidate answer.
blocks.zh: 差异扩散的机制。 我们发现Gemma 2 的较大模型对主元件的情感差异较小,而参与率则随尺度而上升,TwoNN分数估计保持不变(§5.2). 下一个测试是对情感特征和人类评级的预作,仅来自主要组成部分,仅从其余组成部分,以及来自各细胞的对应组成部分预算,这询问主要方向之外的差异是否有助于信号。 如果确实如此,在Gemma 2 9B调制下验证的工具链Presa和Teles de Oliveira(2026年)上的稀有地貌分解是表达该信号所代表的内容的工具. 他们的发现是,欢乐和欢乐只在几个特点的共同指导下出现,这是一个候选的答案。

blocks.en: Arousal correlation with scale. We observed that the arousal correlation on the second component rises from 2B to 27B in both chains, though we classified this as a lead rather than a result because registered tests did not confirm it (§5.3). Larger models may hold more arousal information, or the second component may simply catch a larger share of the same amount, since the second and third components together recover about as much arousal in every cell (Appendix E) and reading 2B one layer deeper closes most of the base chain’s gap (§5.3). The next test is a measure of the arousal linearly recoverable from a pre-stated low-dimensional subspace, scored on held-out emotions over a depth band rather than at one layer. That measure would split the second-component rise into two parts, the share that is new arousal information and the share that is arousal moving between components.
blocks.zh: 与规模的惊人关联。 我们注意到,在两个链条中,第二部分的激发相关性从2B上升到27B,尽管我们将此列为铅而不是结果,因为已登记的测试没有证实这一点(第5.3节)。 更大的模型可能持有更刺激的信息,或者第二个组件可能只是捕捉到相同数量的较大份额,因为第二和第三个组件一起在每一个细胞(附录E)中恢复了大约同样程度的刺激,读取2B一层更深地拉近了基链的大部分缺口(§5.3)。 接下来的测试是从一个被预设的低维子空间中测出振荡线性可恢复的度量,在被悬浮的情绪上得分于一个深度波段而不是一层. 这一措施将把第二个组成部分分成两个部分,即新的振奋信息份额和在各组成部分之间的振动份额。
